reports as required

○ Support Team in basic operational and program/event requirements for the annual event(s).

description:
Job Description – Steward

**Job Title:** Steward  
**Department:** Food \& Beverages  
**Reports To:** F\&B Manager

Job Purpose

To support the Food \& Beverages Department by ensuring timely distribution of food to patients, maintaining cleanliness and hygiene in the kitchen and pantry, and assisting in the smooth functioning of food service operations.

* Ensure breakfast, soup, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner are delivered to patients on time.

* Follow hospital hygiene standards, food safety regulations, and infection control policies at all times.
* Assist the kitchen team during meal preparation and service whenever required.
* Handle food with care and ensure hygienic practices during transportation and serving.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the F\&B Manager or Management.

Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Standard or equivalent.
* Previous experience in a hospital, hotel, or catering service is preferred.

Skills Required

* Basic knowledge of food hygiene and sanitation.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Physically fit to handle food transportation and cleaning activities.
* Punctual, responsible, and disciplined.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts ( No night shifts), including weekends and public holidays, as required.
* Requires standing for long periods, lifting food containers, and performing cleaning duties.

title: Sourcing Manager (Thane) (Mandate)
description:
### **1\. Job Summary**


We are looking for a proactive and well\-connected Sourcing Manager – Channel Sales to build and manage relationships with channel partners, brokers, and real estate consultants to generate qualified leads and site visits for our projects.  

  

The ideal candidate should have strong networking abilities, excellent relationship management skills, and experience working with channel partners in residential and commercial real estate projects in Central Market \- Vikhrol, Ghatkopar till Mulund.  

  

This role plays a critical part in expanding the broker network and ensuring a steady pipeline of buyers and investors.


### **2\. Key Responsibilities**


A. Channel Partner Development


* Identify, onboard, and activate new channel partners, brokers, and real estate consultants.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing brokerage networks.
* Expand the company’s channel partner ecosystem in **Thane** and surrounding markets.

B. Lead Generation \& Sourcing


* Generate qualified leads and site visits through channel partners.
* Ensure a consistent pipeline of potential buyers and investors.
* Coordinate closely with the Sales Closing team to convert sourced leads into bookings.

C. Broker Engagement


* Conduct broker meets, networking events, and project presentations.
* Keep channel partners updated about inventory, pricing, offers, and project highlights.
* Ensure partners actively promote the project in the market.

D. Site Visit Coordination


* Arrange and coordinate site visits for channel partners and their clients.  

Support channel partners during project presentations and client interactions.

E. Market Intelligence


* Track competitor projects, pricing trends, and broker feedback.  

Provide insights on market sentiment and buyer demand.

F. Reporting \& Tracking


* Maintain records of channel partners, leads generated, and site visits conducted.
* Track performance of channel partners and sourcing activities.

### **3\. Requirements \& Experience**


* 2–6 years of experience in real estate channel sales / sourcing.
* Experience working with channel partners for residential and commercial projects.
* Strong broker network in **Thane** market.

### **3\. Skills**


* Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to motivate and activate channel partners.
* Strong understanding of the real estate brokerage ecosystem.

### **4\. Education**


* Bachelor’s degree preferred.

### **5\. Key Competencies**


* Channel partner management
* Broker networking
* Lead sourcing and pipeline generation
* Relationship management
* Market intelligence
* Target\-driven performance

### **6\. Performance Metrics**


* Number of channel partners onboarded and activated
* Leads and site visits generated through channel partners
* Contribution to overall project sales
* Broker engagement and retention

title: Regional Talent Acquisition Lead – APAC
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Regional Talent Acquisition Lead – APAC**

**Bangalore**

**Why join Rolls\-Royce?**

* At Rolls\-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.
* By joining Rolls\-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world\-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high\-performance culture.

**Summary**

This role is accountable for the delivery and evolution of Talent Acquisition service in region including Mid\-Careers and Early Careers delivery. Reporting to the Head of Talent Acquisition, you’ll work in partnership with the business, alongside TA Leads for other regions and outsourced providers to bring to life and operationalise TA strategy. You’ll be responsible for the supply \& demand relationship with our internal customers, overseeing the successful delivery of business\-critical hiring needs, and aligning employer branding to deliver business need for your region. Through these critical partnerships internally and in the external market you’ll bring expertise and insight and set the standards for best in market TA delivery and user experience.


**What you will be doing:**

* Regional Delivery: Accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of Talent Acquisition service for your region (APAC) across all employment categories (excluding Executive hires).
* Enterprise delivery: Work in collaboration with the global TA team, broader GBS teams and our supplier network to translate regional and divisional requirements into one Enterprise TA solution.
* Establish best in class benchmarks: Through effective vendor management and operational leadership, optimise the working partnership with our recruitment outsource provider and set the standards for best\-in\-class service provision.
* Vendor management: Closely monitor operational delivery and establish clear expectations with our vendors with regards best practice delivery. Where required you will implement and drive performance improvement programmes – working in partnership with our procurement teams to ensure we are receiving cost competitive, reliable and high performing support from our suppliers.
* Early Careers leadership: work as part of the Early Careers delivery team as the lead for Early Careers in region. You will translate regional hiring demand into an effective brand, attraction and selection strategy, help shape programme strategy for region, and ensure effective frameworks are in place to deliver required outcomes and optimise user experience
* Partnership across talent spectrum: Work in close partnership with the Executive Talent team to ensure consistency of brand and experience whilst optimising end to end delivery to ensure the talent flow from early career through mid\-career to “talent to value” roles is cohesive.
* Continuous improvement: Work as an integral part of the global TA team to oversee and shape technology, operational and process improvement projects for your region –achieving a balance of global consistency vs. regional need.
* Stakeholder Management: Manage regional stakeholders to ensure that they are ‘brought on the journey’ of Talent Acquisition services and its evolution.
* Transformation: Be the voice for your region in helping to shape the global evolution of TA, delivering local transformation improvements that can make our Talent Acquisition approach world class.
* Tech optimisation: Understand, evaluate, and leverage automation to ensure that our Talent Acquisition strategy is future\-proofed
* Innovate: Use innovative and creative solutions to address business challenges to address the challenges we face today and in pursuit of strategic goals
* Metrics and Reporting: Track recruitment metrics and analyse data to monitor global service delivery. Utilise insights to drive shape and drive improvement plans with suppliers, understand root cause issues, early identification of risk and monitor effective vendor delivery.
* Compliance and Diversity: Ensure compliance with local labour laws, regulations, and internal policies. Actively promote diversity and inclusion initiatives in the recruitment process \- ensuring all activity is aligned to the Diversity and Inclusion strategy and is woven into delivery plans.
* Financial management: in partnership with Head of Talent Acquisition oversee budget and spend for the region. This will include cost projections and budget setting, monitoring ongoing spend and management of invoicing, purchase orders and any required cross charging.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* Subject matter expertise in Talent Acquisition – knowledge of both Mid\-Career (experienced hire) and Early Career is essential
* APAC Geo (Specially India, Singapore) TA experience is mandatory
* Experience of operational leadership and demonstrable and effective vendor management
* Understanding of employment laws, regulations, and diversity/inclusion best practices.
* Experience in translating business strategy to operational demand and best in class delivery
* Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and metrics to drive decision\-making and process improvements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and senior leaders.
* Project delivery and change management experience

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi\-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls\-Royce into a high\-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company.


Join us, and it can be your future vision too. Rolls\-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non\-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.


As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

Human Resources

title: Security Manager - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About the job**


Citi Security \& Investigative Services (CSIS) is a corporate security function operating across more than 100 countries. We are responsible for the security and safety of Citi’s employees and facilities, and we lead Citi’s response during security incidents and crisis events. We value employees who will care about the wellbeing of our employees and will respond with urgency and a sense of ownership towards a diverse range of incidents.


Your main responsibility will be to manage and coordinate the security and safety services in Mumbai and Gujarat for all Citi businesses. The key goal of the position is to maintain a safe environment for clients, employees, to protect the company's assets and respond to security incidents. It also involves the protection of the company’s integrity and reputation.


You will be responsible for developing a local security program and procedures that conform to the Citi Security Policy and Citi Security Standards.


It will be your responsibility to ensure the program meets business requirements and local legal and regulatory requirements.


You will be responsible to design incident response plans and take the lead during physical security and safety incidents.


Your reporting line will be to the Director of Security \- India Subcontinent.


**What Does It Take to Be In This Role**


CSIS takes a risk\-based approach to security protection through implementing physical security measures and security systems which include access control systems, CCTV, and alarm monitoring, and is supplemented by security guarding where required.


The CSIS Security Lead Officer provides security support, guidance, and response to employees from various nationalities and diverse backgrounds.


This role requires the successful candidate to demonstrate high levels of professionalism and confident leadership as well as the ability to interact with senior leadership at Citi, and with external stakeholders such as vendors, local authorities, emergency services and law enforcement.


You will be required to perform regular on\-site reviews to verify the quality of compliance with requirements of the Citi Security Standards, procedures implemented and the standards of our Security Services during all operating hours at Citi Facilities.


**RESPONSIBILITIES** **(What You Will Be Working On)**


* Manage day\-to\-day security operations as well as security incident response, emergency response and crisis management support to the Crisis Management Team.
* Conducting Security Risk Assessments (SRA) for all Citi facilities in accordance with the requirements of the Citi Security Standards.
* Performing quality assurance and using penetration testing and operational readiness exercises as tools to ensure a high state of operational readiness.
* Perform security self\-audits and create and train Security and Safety Administrators to conduct security self\-audits at remote Citi facilities.
* Performing quarterly evaluations on security components and ensuring that any gaps identified through the process are remediated timely and escalated if needed.
* Collaborate with the facility Fire Safety team and support activities associated to requirements of the Fire Safety Procedures intended to ensure safety of Citi Staff.
* Acquiring and managing security vendor services in accordance with Procurement and Third\- Party Management policies and standards.
* Designing and implementing a facility security plan, including monitoring and implementing an Incident Response Procedure.
* Responding to security incidents, investigating incidents/breaches and reporting incidents via the Global Security Management System (GSMS).
* Participating in crisis management with a responsibility for People Safety and Security in partnership with HR, Enterprise Resiliency and other stakeholders.
* Meet the key performance metrics for your area of responsibility.
* Providing clear and concise briefings/advice to management on ongoing major security matters.
* Liaising with CSIS Intelligence, Law Enforcement, Public Private Partnerships, Industry Security Associations and the local ASIS and OSAC chapters to gather intelligence and information on security threats and respond to emerging threats.
* Producing evidence and deliverables as required by Internal Audit, Regulatory Examinators or authorized External Audits on security processes.
* Ensuring security equipment remains functional and current, and liaising with the CSIS Project Management and Technology Team to design replacement or new systems where required.
* Providing support to CSIS Executive Protection when required.
* Supporting visiting travelers during security events.
* Where required, preparing, and submitting licensing applications, security plans and other documentation required by regulators, law enforcement or industry standards organizations.
* Complying with local laws, rules and regulations on security and fire safety procedures.
* Conducting security risk assessments for significant events.
* Building and maintaining effective stakeholder relationships within the organization.
* Manage contingent and contract security staff at various Citi facilities. Ensure appropriate utilization of critical security resources including security guarding.
* Other tasks as assigned by the CSIS Leadership.

**EDUCATION \& PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** **(Tell Us What You’ve Got)**


* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant qualifications and/or apprenticeships/ vocational training programs.
* Relevant professional security qualifications or certifications will be an advantage.

**EXPERIENCE \& ATTRIBUTES** **(What We Are Looking For)**


* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant qualifications and/or apprenticeships/ vocational training programs.
* Professional security qualification or certification will be an advantage.

**EXPERIENCE \& ATTRIBUTES** **(What We Are Looking For)**


* Experience in security management in a corporate, regulatory, consultancy, security operations center, defense or law enforcement environment. However, serious consideration will be given to candidates without security management experience who possess strong audit, controls, risk or compliance capacity, or candidates with strong crisis management experience and geo\-political and international relations. (Required).
* Experience working in a corporate or financial services security team in a leadership role (Desired).
* A deep understanding of security operations, processes, and controls with demonstrated experience in designing a security program at facility level (Required).
* A strong understanding of applicable local laws/statutes as they relate to security (Required).
* Demonstration of verbal and written communication skills in English and fluency in one official local language. (Required).
* Proven experience of providing leadership in managing crisis events or significant security incidents. (Desired)
* Demonstrated ability to find agile solutions to manage a dynamic threat or risk (Desired).
* Knowledge of Operational Risk Management frameworks and regulations for the banking industry (Desired).
* An understanding of the security risks in the relevant cities and countries and the geo\-political risks that might impact the country. (Required)
* Demonstrate the ability to understand who the key internal and external stakeholders are, and how to build relationships and networks to manage stakeholder relationships. (Required)
* Ability to travel, often at short notice (Required).
* Ability to work at different offices within the city (Required).
* Ability to multitask by prioritizing and triaging multiple security incidents.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Demonstrates a desire to continually develop own skills.
* MS Office Word, Excel and Outlook proficiency and ability to adopt available AI tools.
* Demonstrates an appreciation of a diverse workforce.
* Willingness to take on feedback and adapt to CSIS methodologies.

The position may also require the successful candidate to take on additional roles and responsibilities within the India Subcontinent like managing the South Asia Command Center.

title: Associate Director - Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL
description:
**Job title:** **Associate Director – Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL**

 **Some careers have more impact than others.**


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Associate Director – Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Analyze data assets and generate insights aligned with business outcomes and strategic data models. Gather, understand data requirements from stakeholders to design and deliver analytics use cases (e.g. triggers). Deliver analytics PoCs that allow our businesses and clients to identify new opportunities. Responsible to address business challenges in an actionable way by leveraging current and emerging data and analytical techniques.
* Proactively identify opportunities to derive higher returns with improved Data Quality. Review and identify data inconsistencies across consuming systems. Responsible for providing management and direction to cross\-functional experts (pods) from analytics, technology, transformation and product management and key stakeholders across global functions and regions. Ensure implementation of consistent and effective management approach across the functional areas.
* Interface within the Detection Value Stream for all Change and Prioritization matters. Provide guidance and support to Leadership in the delivery of investment across technology, intelligence, and analytics to enhance the efficiency, effectiveness, security and cost profile of FC. Support and provide guidance in developing, driving and implementing programmes to quantify impacts and implement actions to address, manage and mitigate impacts of FC related regulatory changes across the FC control framework. Develop and Manage relationships with key internal stakeholders across Group functions, lines of business, regions, and countries.
* Facilitate the sharing of information and creation of feedback loops across the firm, with particular focus on wider FC Detection stakeholders to continuously adapt and improve change management and optimization. Overseas the support and coordination capability necessary to manage the response to high priority FC Detection Feedback requiring a coordinated response across Group Financial Crime functions, Compliance, lines of business, regions, or countries. Develop and maintain a strong and professional working relationship with Senior Management of FC, Risk, Audit and Finance at Business, Group and Regional levels
* Ensure appropriate timely and relevant risk information is provided to FC leadership and appropriate governance forums. Drive the articulation and embedding of FC Detection Optimization controls. Ensure that these are updated for changes in regulation and impacts on business. Resolve any identified issues promptly and escalate concerns to management as appropriate to ensure timely awareness of any material concerns.
* Maintain and observe all HSBC control standards and implement relevant policies, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal / external auditors and external regulators. Where required, support the articulation and embedding of framework, policies, procedures, and controls as they relate to FC Controls. Maintain awareness of operational risk within the value stream and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
* Develop and present options to implement controls whilst retaining full benefit from investment in systems. Clearly communicate and effectively implement the Change Management and Prioritization strategy to meet business needs. Provide direction at a global level and support at a regional level with respect to the FC Detection change and prioritization processes.
* Influence through action and strong leadership with respect to establishing an effective and efficient Risk Discovery Environment, deliver very strong collaboration and influencing across the Compliance matrix. Provide sponsorship and strategic vision for People Development initiatives aligned to Financial Crime, Compliance, and Group activities, as well as supporting the annual BAU HR cycle. Ensure effective communication across Financial Crime and the business to all key stakeholders in relation to FC Detection matters
* Support the sharing of developments and best practice across the wider FC Function. Support delivers the value stream approach aligned to detection outcomes to deliver a seamless integration of cross\-functional expertise. Maintain and develop positive and professional working relationships with senior business leaders, Risk and Compliance colleagues at Group, Regional and Market / Entity level
* Work effectively as part of a team, taking the lead where appropriate and contributing to team output and collaboration. Foster learning agile culture, promoting proactive review of lessons learned. Support an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects the HSBC brand. Ensures effective and open communication, team building, knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring not only within the function but to the broader organization

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong understanding of Global Financial Crime landscape and the various risk typologies and having good visibility to the eminent changes in landscape.
* Existing Financial Crime Detection capabilities and the limitations therein.
* Awareness of technological advancements in Financial Crime detection capabilities.
* HSBC is an extremely diverse business with significant geographical spread and activities that span a universal banking model, including continuing to innovate to keep abreast of changes in financial services markets globally. Such activity is in an increasingly regulated and complex global environment with often little consistency between laws and regulations in different jurisdictions and regulators taking a far more proactive approach in ensuring local compliance with their requirements and imposing increasingly stringent sanctions for breaches.
* The role will assist the Group in achieving a balance between the demands of regulators, external bodies and governmental initiatives and the Group’s shareholders and customers in enacting FC compliance; being alive to the political, management, regulatory and reputational implications of a particular decision and courses of action at a global level; assisting executive management in the development of controls and systems and influencing the way in which the business is conducted in order to manage these risks, meeting Group risk appetite. The increased focus on individual liability for senior managers, particularly Risk Heads, makes it increasingly important for the Group to be able to provide adequate systems and controls. The role is one where regulatory authority have high expectations and is likely to come under scrutiny as part of any major regulatory investigation.

 **You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

  

Hsbc.com/careers

  

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified people irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
description:
**Role description** **Who We Are:**



Vista’s CFO Organization empowers teams to focus on their domain and serve customers. Clear guardrails pave the way for strong engagement and efficiency in our lines of business, regional operations, and central functions. Team members work cross\-functionally, impacting every area of the company – from human resources, communications and real estate to finance, controllership, and legal services. The CFO team makes critical capabilities accessible, delivering services and information that every employee needs to succeed in their role.



Positioning ourselves centrally and globally, we offer opportunities to scale processes and ideas, facilitate feedback loops across Vista’s organizations and build a team of world\-class talent, with specialized skill sets.



**What You Will Do:**



Vista is building a world\-class finance organization, and we are seeking a highly motivated Senior Financial Analyst to join the FP\&A team. This role will have two main responsibilities –



* Provide finance support for one of our regions. Responsibilities include:


* Perform financial reporting and analysis including:
* Analyze and interpret data to understand key drivers of the financial results to drive actionable insights
* Prepare standardized reports and written analysis for weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews for finance leadership and other key stakeholders
* Drive reporting and process improvements with key users and stakeholders
* Drive our management reporting activities including:
* Drive the annual budget and forecasting processes
* Drive the month\-end close process including review of accounting entries, trends, and operating expenses
* Be a proficient user of Vista’s financial reporting tools
* Communicate across the global finance organization and corporate stakeholders
* Complete ad hoc analysis and other projects as needed.

2\. As a part of FP\&A Centre of Excellence


* Collaborate and work cross\-functionally to improve, standardize, and automate processes leveraging AI and other advanced tools.
* Utilize AI tools \& data visualization for business insights
* Proactively contribute to the team projects along with the regional requirements

This remote\-first position will be based in Bengaluru, India and report to FP\&A Manager.

  


**Your Qualifications:**



At Vista, we value the experiences that individual team members add to our culture. Please don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet the exact qualifications, we look forward to learning more about you!


* Previous experience working in a high performing team
* Ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast\-paced environment
* Intellectual curiosity and comfort driving progress independently
* Strong understanding of financial statements and profitability drivers
* Fluent in English and excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Experience with Data Visualization Tools (i.e. Tableau, Looker) and advanced Excel skills
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or similar field. CA preferred.
* 3\-5\+ years progressive work experience in FP\&A or similar field

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**



Being at Vista means that you dn’t see work as just a building, a desk, or a manufacturing floor. You see it as a chance to take a step forward in your career journey – and your life. We strive to give you everything you need to learn, grow, and succeed. Through innovation, collaboration, and perpetual exposure to what’s next, we are always pushing boundaries and broadening our horizons. We embrace the chance to operate outside of our comfort zone to discover what we are capable of. Some might call that a challenge; we just call it another great day at work.



Vista has received numerous recognitions including a perfect score of 100 on the Human Rights Campaign Foundation’s 2021 Corporate Equality Index (CEI) naming us a Best Places to Work for LGBTQ Equality. We also earned a place as one of the best remote\-first workplaces in the U.S. and on the Boston Best Places to Work list from Built In. In addition, Vista was recently honored with Comparably’s Best CEOs award according to employees. Vista offers numerous support systems including Employee Resource Groups like Pride, Mosaic, and Women in Technology, and special interest communities to foster awareness, respect, and inclusion within the workplace.



**We are Remote\-First:**



In 2020, Vista adopted a Remote\-First operating model and culture. We heard from our team members that having the freedom, autonomy, and trust in each other to work from home and the ability to operate when they are most productive, empowers them to be their best. Vista also provides collaboration spaces for team members to work physically together when it's safe to do so and when in\-person collaboration will deliver the best results. Currently we are enabled to hire remote team members in over 30\+ US States as well as several countries in Europe, including Spain, Germany, UK, Czech Republic, the Netherlands, Ireland and Switzerland.



**About Us:**



As an e\-commerce powerhouse, Vista creates customer value (and delight) through accessible, cutting\-edge technology. We are the marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For more than 20 years, we have helped small businesses look and feel credible through high\-quality marketing products and solutions that include signage, logo apparel, promotional products, face masks, flyers, postcards, business cards, websites and digital marketing. With Vista, small businesses are able to create and customize their marketing with easy\-to\-use digital tools and design\-templates, or by receiving expert graphic design support. In 2020, Vista acquired 99designs to expand its design offering via a worldwide community of more than 150,000 talented designers to make it easy for designers and clients to work together to create designs they love. Vista is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in\-store, online and on\-the\-go.



**Equal Opportunity Employer:**



Vista, a Cimpress company, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.

 **Skills**  

FP\&A, forecasting, data visualization tools

 **About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

**Your role**
=============

**What you'll be doing**
========================

**What We Need**


Corpay is currently looking to hire a Human Resources Manager within our Human Resources department. This position is located in Nagpur, India. This position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence across the HR function by leading strategic HR operations initiatives, enhancing workforce analytics, and optimizing HR processes and systems. The ideal candidate is a data\-driven HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about improving the employee and manager experience through operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

**How We Work**


As a Human Resource Manager, you will be expected to work in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment, partnering closely with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and Centers of Excellence. Depending on business needs, this role may operate in a hybrid or onsite work environment.

**Role Responsibilities**


In this role, you will:

* Lead enterprise\-wide HR operations initiatives focused on automation, process optimization, workforce data governance, and compliance.
* Provide strategic workforce insights and recommendations to HR Business Partners and business leaders through advanced HR analytics and data interpretation.
* Oversee the delivery of HR reporting, dashboards, workforce metrics, and workforce planning inputs that support business decision\-making.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across HR systems, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve efficiency, scalability, and data accuracy.
* Partner with HR leadership on high\-impact organizational initiatives, including reorganizations, policy implementation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Establish and maintain governance processes that ensure HR data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology and automation to streamline HR operations and improve service delivery.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including HRIS, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, and IT to support enterprise HR initiatives.
* Develop executive\-ready reports and presentations that communicate workforce trends, operational performance, and strategic recommendations.
* Mentor and develop HR analysts while fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the HR organization.
**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
* 7\+ years of progressive HR Operations, HR Analytics, HRIS, or Human Resources experience.
* Experience leading HR operations, workforce analytics, or shared services functions in a complex, global organization.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate workforce data into actionable business insights.
* Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and workforce planning models.
* Demonstrated knowledge of HR compliance, governance, and HR data management best practices.
* Experience driving process improvement, automation, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Proven ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization and influence stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience working with enterprise HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or UKG is preferred.

* Competitive salary package
* Career development opportunities in fintech
* Exposure to global clients and innovative payment solutions
* Health insurance and flexible work options

title: Manager, Paid Media
description:
**About Learneo**  

Learneo is a platform of builder\-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

**About Quillbot**  

Quillbot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals—especially those learning English—strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, Quillbot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI\-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.


**Role Overview**  

We're seeking a data\-driven and strategic Manager for Paid Media to lead our paid marketing initiatives. This role is pivotal in driving scalable growth, optimizing media performance, and contributing to our full\-funnel marketing strategy. You'll work cross\-functionally with other Marketing teams, Data, Engineering, Product and Finance teams to improve our performance


**Responsibilities**


* Lead the Paid Media budget plan and allocation strategy across products, geos, languages, and channels, optimizing for Return on Investment and Lifetime Value
* Own end\-to\-end campaign strategy and execution across multiple platforms: Google Search, DV360, PMax, Meta, UAC, and ASA, among others. From strategy and setup to bid management and creative testing programs.
* Own audience strategy across the funnel, including segmentation, remarketing, and lookalike audiences, to maximize reach efficiency and conversion
* Define the measurement framework: own attribution infrastructure, incrementality testing, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) to ensure investment decisions are grounded in causal evidence. Work in close collaboration with the Data and Engineering team.
* Manage relationships with agencies, platform partnerships, and vendor agreements, including negotiations, renewals, and performance accountability
* Build, develop, and mentor the paid media team, set clear goals, improve ways of working, and create conditions for high performance
* Deliver regular performance reporting tied to business outcomes, CAC, ROAS, LTV, CPI, with clear recommendations for leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Continuously evaluate and pilot emerging ad formats, AI\-powered campaign types (incl. AI Max), and platform innovations to keep the paid media function ahead of market shifts

description:

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.**Information Technology \& Digital**
-------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  

  

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  

  

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.**About the role**
------------------



The IT\&D Manager, IT Service Delivery is accountable for the end\-to\-end service delivery, operational performance, and continual improvement of IT applications and services aligned to a defined Business Capability Stream (e.g. HR, Finance, ERP, Supply, Marketing, R\&D) within a predominantly outsourced operating model.



This role acts as the single point of accountability for service outcomes, ensuring that strategic service providers deliver stable, resilient, secure, and business\-aligned services that meet agreed SLAs, XLAs, and contractual commitments. The role serves as the primary business\-facing IT partner, translating business priorities into operational requirements and orchestrating internal IT teams and multiple suppliers to deliver seamless, high\-quality services.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------



1\. End\-to\-End Service Accountability  

* Own the end\-to\-end operational performance of all applications and services within the assigned capability stream, regardless of supplier or delivery tower.
* Act as the business\-facing service owner, accountable for availability, reliability, performance, and user experience.
* Ensure services are operated as integrated end\-to\-end value streams, not disconnected vendor silos.

  

2\. Supplier \& SIAM\-Oriented Service Orchestration  

* Lead and govern strategic managed service providers, SaaS vendors, and system integrators delivering application and service support.
* Operate as part of a SIAM\-style model, ensuring clear RACI, handoffs, and collaboration across multiple suppliers.
* Hold suppliers accountable for outcomes, not effort, including SLA performance, incident quality, proactive problem prevention, and continuous improvement.

  

3\. Service Performance \& Governance  

* Define, manage, and continuously improve SLAs, XLAs and KPIs aligned to business priorities and critical business events.
* Ensure transparent, accurate, and meaningful reporting focused on:


o Business impact  

o Service stability  

o User experience  

o Root cause and trend insights  

  

4\. Stakeholder \& Business Relationship Management  

* Serve as the primary IT service delivery partner for senior stakeholders within the aligned capability stream.
* Translate business demand, priorities, and pain points into service delivery objectives and supplier commitments.
* Proactively communicate service health, risks, and improvement actions using clear, business\-focused language.
* Represent operational readiness, risk, and service impact in business governance forums.

  

5\. Incident, Major Incident \& Problem Management  

* Ensure robust incident and major incident management across suppliers, including escalation, coordination, and communications.
* Drive Problem Management discipline across vendors, ensuring root causes are identified, recurring issues eliminated, and permanent fixes delivered.
* Hold suppliers accountable for preventable incidents and repeat failures.

  

6\. Change, Release \& Service Transition Oversight  

* Govern supplier\-led change and release activities to balance speed, stability, and risk.
* Accountable for service transition readiness for new systems, enhancements, or supplier changes, including:


o Support models  

o Knowledge transfer  

o Runbooks  

o Monitoring and alerting  

o Service desk enablement  

  

7\. Operational Risk, Resilience \& Compliance  

* Identify and manage service delivery risks across suppliers, including capacity, resilience, security, and compliance.
* Ensure services adhere to internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.

  

8\. Continual Improvement, Automation \& Efficiency  

* Use incident, problem, and performance data to prioritise improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation, simplification, and standardisation across suppliers to:


o Reduce manual effort  

o Improve stability  

o Lower run costs  

o Enhance user experience  

  

9\. Financial \& Contractual Management (Run Services)  

* Manage run\-state costs associated with the service portfolio, including vendor spend and support contracts.
* Ensure cost transparency and value\-for\-money from service providers.
* Support commercial governance, contract compliance, and service demand prioritisation.
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Proven experience leading IT service delivery in an outsourced or SIAM\-based environment.
* Strong expertise in ITIL\-based service management (incident, problem, change, service transition, service level management).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple suppliers and drive end\-to\-end service outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with senior business leaders.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP, Siebel, SuccessFactors, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM).
* Financial and vendor commercial management experience.
* Exposure to automation, observability, and modern operations practices (AIOps concepts).
* Deep hands\-on experience with ServiceNow as the enterprise IT Service Management platform, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management.
* Understanding of ServiceNow CMDB, service mapping, and dependency modelling to enable true end\-to\-end service ownership.
* Experience defining and governing ITSM workflows, SLAs/XLAs, dashboards, and reporting within ServiceNow, and using ServiceNow data and insights to drive operational performance, problem reduction, and continual service improvement.

  

What Success Looks Like  

* Stable, predictable services with minimal business disruption
* Suppliers operating as one integrated service ecosystem
* Reduced incident volumes and repeat issues
* Clear service ownership and accountability
* Improved business satisfaction and trust in IT delivery
**The skills for success**
--------------------------



Service Delivery, IT Operations, SIAM, ITIL

**Description**

The World Bank Group is a unique global partnership of five institutions driven by a bold vision to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. As one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries, we help solve the world’s greatest development challenges. When you join the World Bank Group, you become part of a dynamic, diverse organization with 189 member countries and 182 offices worldwide. We work with public and private sector partners, invest in groundbreaking projects, and use data, research, and technology to bring tangible and transformative change around the globe. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org


**Vice\-Presidency Context**


The WBG Budget and Procurement (WBP) is organized into five Departments: WBP Centers of Excellence (WBPCE) with teams supporting the corporate strategic business and budget planning process, providing WBP systems, knowledge, and shared services; WBP IBRD/IDA Regional Units (WBPRU) with teams supporting IBRD/IDA clients in the regions; WBP IFC/MIGA Budget Partners (CSRDR) with teams supporting IFC/MIGA clients in the HQ and the regions; WBP Corporate Units (WBPCU) with teams supporting the Knowledge Bank and corporate units and providing capital budget support; and WBP Corporate Procurement (WBPCP) with teams providing group\-wide procurement services.


**Unit Context**


Steps to continue evolving the management structure of WBPCP with its strategic priorities present the opportunity to recruit for an expanded managerial role in the Department. In line with the WBP global footprint strategy and delivery model, the location of the positions may be Washington D.C., Chennai, or Sofia. In accordance with World Bank Group policy, positions in Country Offices, irrespective of level, are subject to local recruitment. Selections to positions outside of Washington D.C. will be LRS. Business needs and candidate preference will be considered in determining the actual location of each of the positions described below:


Manager, Procurement Operations \& Advisory is responsible for all operational and advisory functions within the Corporate Procurement department. These include the Corporate Procurement Service Desk, Order Management, Vendor Management, governance monitoring, systems support and administration, and regional procurement advisory, amongst others. Manages a global team of 35 staff based in the HQ, Global Business Centers (GBC), and in each of the seven regions of the WBG to support the decentralized footprint of WBG clients.


**Duties and accountabilities:**


Manager, WBPPS has the following three areas of responsibility:


**A)Business Management Responsibilities**


* Manage the teams providing planning, budgeting, and performance reporting services; conducting analytical work and providing advisory services in areas of focus (e.g., operations, investments in technology); and providing other services as needed over time.


* Is an active member of the WBP Leadership Team, participates in cross cutting activities, and from time to time, takes on leadership roles in WBP\-wide activities, such as recruitment and other HR initiatives.


* Provides support and advice to the Vice President and the Director of WBP, Corporate Procurement as requested.


**B)Talent Management Responsibilities**


* Manages the unit staff, including recruitment, evaluation, and career development of staff.


* Provides leadership and support to her/his staff to build sustainable finance skills and capacity to effectively deliver WBP services.


* Manages and oversees the engagement and evaluation of technical consultants within the WBPCP unit, as needed.


**C)Budget Management Responsibilities**


* Effectively and efficiently manages his/her unit’s resources, ensuring its effective formulation and input into budget decisions.


* Advocates and drives cost\-effective delivery of business finance services, promoting transparency, simplicity, standardization, and automation.

**Selection Criteria**


The successful candidate should be recognized for an ability to get things done, strategic thinking and execution leadership, reputation and track record leading large business transformation initiatives, being a problem\-solver, and possessing accomplishments relevant to the WBG’s strategic agenda.


The successful candidate will have an active interest in the activities of the World Bank Group, its mission, products and services in addition to having a strong work ethics and unquestionable integrity, and should possess strong leadership in multicultural environment, and analytical abilities as well as excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills adaptable to all audiences, including Board level.


The candidate should have a minimum of a Master’s degree in relevant field/discipline (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, etc.), coupled with a minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in procurement, with a strong track record of success in leading and managing complex procurement operations.


The ideal candidate should also possess as many of the following professional and personal characteristics as possible:


* Deep understanding of procurement principles, practices, and regulations, including international procurement standards.


* Strong strategic orientation and ability to manage successfully large work programs and extensively decentralized teams.


* Demonstrated ability to conceptualize complex issues with future focused systematic thinking and frame problems as actionable issues with ability to develop consensus among diverse constituents.


* Proven ability to balance client concerns with wider corporate concerns as well as proven ability to interact effectively with WBG and external counterparts.


* Proven change integrator with ability to effectively lead and implement complex change management initiatives.


* Strong understanding of the workings of the organizational context including the matrix environment with deep functional knowledge of the challenges of resource deployment in Operations.


* Demonstrated effectiveness in collaboration across the Organization including Operations and Corporate functions and proven ability to build common goals and solutions while managing different views.


WBG Managerial Competencies

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

title: Vessel Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.

**Position Description:**



The Vessel Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and economical operation of assigned vessels. The position applies knowledge of engineering, HR\-management, shipping\-industry regulations, commercial and legal considerations, and guides sea\-staff onboard assigned vessels. The Vessel Manager also takes initiative to continuously improve the performance of assigned ships and strengthens the teamwork between ship and office.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


* To be familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members either of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Guides, advises, and monitor vessel operations; also assists crew performing vessel maintenance
* Researches technical information related to equipment breakdowns, malfunctions, improvements, upgrades or modifications for the reliable long\-term performance of the vessels
* Prepares for scheduled dry dockings, surveys and repairs on assigned ships, and arranges and manages supply of spares, stores, and services to vessels before scheduled maintenance and breakdown repairs
* Manages vessels in full compliance with local and international rules and regulations; and with Seaspan’s Safety Management System (SMS)
* Analyses ships’ performance and relays this information to the onboard master and chief engineer; ensures compliance with current charter\-party terms of employment and other commercial concerns
* Ensures compliance with all necessary operational certification and survey requirements applicable to assigned vessels
* Visits vessels port; may sail with Seaspan ships to reasonably ascertain that they are operated in a safe, reliable and economical way
* Monitors function and performance during ship visits and initiates effective problem solving of on\-board issues, including technical, quality\-assurance, health and safety, commercial or personnel issues
* Takes ownership of on\-board issues and follows them through to resolution
* Prepares budgets in the required detail for the yearly operation of assigned ships, scheduled dry dockings, surveys, repairs and ad\-hoc modifications and repairs within required timelines
* Monitors expenses of assigned vessels and submits monthly variance reporting and tracks against budget
* Ensures that all reporting employees adhere to company policies and procedures
* Communicates expectations to direct reports; manages performance and provides leadership and support to team members
* Demonstrates commitment to Seaspan’s Maritime Resource Management values
* Performs other duties as required

  


**Requirements:**


* Must have at least one year of experience as a technical superintendent in a company managing handy\-max sized (or larger) vessels engaged in international trading and must have a minimum of one full year in rank as a chief engineer orhave completed three contracts as a chief engineer with Seaspan
* English language skills, both verbal and written, must be effective and suitable for a multi\-cultural working environment
* Strong technical knowledge
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* Class 1 marine engineer certificate
* Degree in marine engineering or equivalent

  

  

**Additional Desired Qualifications:**


* Experience working with container ships
* Education in mechanical engineering or naval architecture
* Previous experience with new\-builds and dry\-dockings preferred

  


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**


* Regular international travel is required and may be on short notice
* Must have mobility to conduct vessel inspections
* Will be required to carry a mobile device and check regularly outside of office hours
* Must maintain a home internet connection for work outside of office hours


Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
**RemoFirst** is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all\-in\-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

We are a small but strong team of 200\+ people (and growing) hyper\-focused on delivering a world\-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry\-leading partnerships.  



We are seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to optimize and scale our revenue operations across the full customer lifecycle. Reporting at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Partnerships, this role will own key operational processes including CRM administration, sales compensation, reporting, enablement, and revenue systems. You will drive process improvements, support strategic initiatives, and ensure our revenue teams have the tools, processes, and insights they need to succeed.



This is a highly cross\-functional role requiring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment.



### **Key Responsibilities**


* Partner with Sales, SDR, and Partner teams to optimize CRM workflows, improve sales processes, administer PandaDoc, support revenue tools, and execute cross\-functional operational initiatives.
* Own the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the CRM, ensuring data integrity, process consistency, and user adoption.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
* Design and deliver monthly Sales Enablement training sessions in partnership with Sales leadership, including topic selection, presentation development, and training delivery.
* Own the monthly sales commission calculation process within Remuner, ensuring accuracy and compliance with compensation plans.
* Partner with the Finance team to ensure timely and accurate commission disbursements.
* Own the Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) reporting process and prepare recurring management reports to provide visibility into revenue performance.
* Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports that support sales performance, pipeline visibility, forecasting, and executive decision\-making.
* Support ad hoc Request for Proposal (RFP) responses and other strategic initiatives as needed.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Account Executives and other revenue team members on CRM, compensation, sales tools, reporting, and operational processes.
* Collaborate across Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Leadership to document, standardize, and continuously improve revenue operations processes.
### **What you'll need:**


* 5–10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Sales Compensation, CRM Administration, or a related field.
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into operational improvements.
* Experience administering CRM platforms and supporting revenue technology stacks.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex processes clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes, automate workflows, and drive operational efficiencies.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
### **Nice to have:**


* Experience with Employer of Record (EOR), Professional Employer Organization (PEO), or contractor management platforms.
* Experience with HubSpot CRM, PandaDoc, Apollo, and business intelligence (BI) tools.
* Experience administering or managing commission software such as Remuner.
* Familiarity with SaaS business models and recurring revenue metrics, including Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), and customer lifecycle reporting.
### **Why work at RemoFirst?**


* **Startup environment.** RemoFirst is an early\-stage start\-up. You have a voice, and can influence and grow rapidly.
* **Build \& Scale From Scratch.** Experience hyper\-growth scale and help us build a great team of professionals worldwide that can help us achieve this ambitious vision.
* **Work for a Market Leader.** Scale a project that counts market\-leading companies like Microsoft, Mastercard, and more as happy customers.
* **Compensation and perks are great!** Competitive compensation. 100% remote work. PTO regulated by local statutory.
* **Culture.** We lead with respect, kindness, and the right to fail. We value hard, yet smart work. Diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA. As we grow and evolve, we welcome your input to help us define our culture further.

  


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

At Target, we value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic relationships and believe every team member’s voice matters.

 **Overview of Target in India**  

Target’s success is driven by a timeless purpose and a proven strategy, brought to life by talented teams across the globe. In India, Target operates as a fully integrated part of its global organization, with more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru supporting enterprise\-wide strategy, technology and operations.  **About the Team**  

Target Human Resources is well known for its signature ability to build the very best teams, and we infuse our work with Target’s distinctive retail brand by continuously experimenting, evolving and innovating. With the chance to positively impact nearly 400,000 people worldwide in our stores, distribution centers and headquarters, you’ll be a strategic partner to the both the leaders and team members who elevate and nurture the Target guest experience. Our dynamic, passionate and responsive team comprises specialized people\-professionals from several diverse disciplines. We operate behind the scenes to create a progressive culture of value, respect, reward and professional advancement. Working with HR Operations, you’ll focus on the powerful and innovative systems and technologies that team members depend on to manage both work and life. Whether it’s time reporting or team member training, these critical systems keep things running smoothly. HR Operations is service\-oriented, and puts team member success at the heart of our activities. As a **Sr. Specialist HR Shared Services**, you will professionally, efficiently, and accurately assist clients, comprised of HR team members and non\-HR team members, via various communication platforms in our HR Operations Center. This includes developing and maintaining a detailed knowledge of resources available regarding HR tools, technology, policies, and procedures. You will problem\-solve by researching, partnering, and following\-up on issues while fostering client relationships, utilizing de\-escalation tactics, and maintaining a high level of confidentiality. As assigned, you’ll act as a workload captain monitoring service levels and coordinating daily schedules to optimize team success.

* Deliver results with short learning period.

* 1\-2 years of work experience
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Good organizational skills and ability to multi\-task
* Typing and computer skills; knowledge of the Microsoft Office Package
* Flexibility to shift rotation, including night and weekend shifts.
* Team Player/Attitude and Self\-motivated
* Attention to detail and the ability to maintain established team quality standards
* Good problem solving skills and innovative skills

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Success will be measured by your ability to identify, attract, and assess applicants as well as facilitate a defined recruiting process. Knowledge of multiple recruiting sources with mastery in one or more. Proven understanding of Recruiting and sourcing concepts, AIRS, Boolean etc. Proven ability to handle multiple projects

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

This role requires a proactive sourcing professional with a strong understanding of technology talent markets and the ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.

Attendance \& Leave Management

Employee Relations

* Support employee engagement initiatives and HR communication.
* Ensure implementation of HR policies and procedures across the organization.

Exit Management

* Coordinate employee resignations, exit interviews, No Dues clearance, and Full \& Final Settlement.
* Ensure timely completion of separation formalities and documentation.

Reporting \& Documentation

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR MIS reports.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR records.
* Assist in HR audits and process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Experience

* Minimum **4 years** of experience in HR Operations.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**About VJX Research**  
VJX Research is a New Delhi\-based family office investment firm being built from the ground up. We invest in listed and unlisted equities across Indian markets, with a focus on identifying high\-quality businesses with durable competitive advantages. To start, our primary focus is listed Indian equities\-mid, small, and micro\-cap names\- with unlisted opportunities becoming a larger part of the mandate over time. The firm is in its earliest phase: team, systems, brand, and process are all being built now, with the longer\-term goal of a recognized investment platform with an established research team and eventually a formal structure to manage external capital.

**About the Role**  
This is a foundational role on a very small, early team, where the work you do directly shapes how coverage, process, and research quality get built from scratch. You won't be slotted into an existing system, you'll help create it. As the platform grows, the role grows with it: from broad, hands\-on coverage today toward owning a defined area with real depth and independence over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build thorough, well\-reasoned coverage of listed Indian companies, financial models, a real view on the business beyond the numbers, and management engagement where possible
* Include 1–2 micro\-cap names a month as part of your coverage
* Develop select coverage into research pieces we publish publicly, educational and analytical, not buy or sell recommendations
* Build your own network with company management over time, and help identify and coordinate meetings for the founder
* Stay genuinely engaged with markets broadly\-reading widely and contributing your own ideas and perspective, not just executing assigned coverage
* Present your work on a regular basis, with the emphasis on steady, high\-quality progress over hitting a fixed quota

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree required
* CFA Level 1 (cleared or pursuing) or CA (qualified or pursuing) preferred, though not mandatory for a strong candidate
* Genuine, demonstrated interest in financial markets and investing
* Real intellectual curiosity and the ability to think and write clearly
* Comfortable with close collaboration early on and increasing ownership over time

**What We Offer**

* Salary of ₹5–9L per annum, commensurate with experience and quality
* Direct mentorship from the founder and a senior analyst
