title: RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

title: Data Engineer (Fresher)
description:
Are you a recent graduate looking to start your career as a Data Engineer, building smart workflows that save time and reduce manual effort?


At TORM, our corporate and technology teams work closely together to drive the business forward through innovation and process automation. By combining strong technical skills with a collaborative mindset, we enable scalable, reliable automation solutions across the organization.


As a Fresher Data Engineer, you'll get hands‑on exposure to building automation workflows and scripts, with some exposure to data pipelines, working alongside experienced engineers to deliver reliable solutions for fleet and shore‑based operations.


**Your Role**


In this role, you'll be part of a high‑performing Data \& AI team, learning to build and support automation workflows and scripts end to end. You'll work closely with senior engineers, get mentorship on best practices, and steadily take ownership of tasks that automate repetitive, manual processes across the business.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows using Python to eliminate repetitive, manual business processes
* Schedule, monitor, and maintain automation jobs, ensuring they run reliably and flagging failures early
* Apply data structures and algorithms (DSA) concepts to write efficient, scalable automation code
* Write and optimize SQL queries to support automation workflows that read from or write to databases
* Debug and troubleshoot issues in automation jobs, escalating and documenting fixes
* Assist with basic data pipeline tasks \- extracting, validating, and loading data \- in support of automation and reporting needs
* Collaborate with the team to test, validate, and deploy automation solutions across Dev/Test/Prod environments
* Maintain clear documentation for scripts, workflows, and processes built


We're looking for a motivated fresher who is curious about automation and scripting, enjoys problem‑solving, and is eager to learn in a collaborative, technology‑driven environment.


**To do well in this role, you bring:**


* 0–1 year of experience
* Strong foundation in Python programming
* Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
* Solid understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) and problem‑solving ability
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong analytical and logical thinking, with a willingness to learn new tools and technologies
* Good communication and collaboration skills
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken


**Good to Have**


* Exposure to Databricks or other cloud data platforms
* Awareness of Generative AI concepts, such as LLMs and prompt engineering
* Familiarity with Azure or other cloud environments
* Any personal or academic projects involving automation, scripting, or data pipelines


**What We Offer**


At TORM, we are committed to people, communities, and the environment. We offer a competitive salary, along with a bonus scheme, pension, and flexible work hours to help you maintain a healthy balance between your personal and professional life. We know that life can be unpredictable, which is why we provide the support you need to manage personal commitments, whether it’s caring for family or taking time for yourself.


We believe development happens continuously, which is why you'll have access to learning opportunities, mentorship from experienced engineers, and the chance to build your skills in data engineering, automation, Databricks, and GenAI from the ground up and also a variety of local initiatives here, e.g., Fun club, Torm Family Day, Festival celebrations, CSR programs that help you connect, grow, and thrive.


At TORM, diversity and inclusion are integral to our performance. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to share their unique perspectives and join us in building a diverse and inclusive future for the shipping industry.


**How to Apply**


Interested in joining the team? Submit your application via www.torm.com/careers by 26 July 2026\.


We look forward to hearing from you!


Our people are our real assets – and we are more than 3,500 colleagues across the globe working together to supply our customers with the energy products they need. Safely, efficiently, and reliably. We believe in ensuring the best possible working environment for everyone in TORM – both at sea and in our offices. We believe in our people with their diverse backgrounds and value their unique skills and contribution to the organization. By working together in a professional, international and informal atmosphere, we can bring out the best in everyone and deliver outstanding results.  

  

TORM is a world\-leading specialist carrier of energy and clean petroleum products, listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and New York. We have a unique business model where we own and operate our fleet of more than 85 vessels and integrate all key shipping competencies in\-house.

  

  

  

**Application due:**
7/26/2026  

**Location:**  

Mumbai, India  


**Homepage:**  

www.torm.com/careers

title: DVA Modeler (Dimensional Variation Analysis Engineer)

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.

* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

description:
**About the Company**

Established in 1910, Hari Chand Anand (HCA) is one of India's largest and most established sales, service, and distribution companies for industrial sewing machines, garment automation equipment, and textile machinery. With a nationwide network spanning Delhi, Kolkata, Bangalore, Chennai, Tirupur, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Kanpur, and Indore, HCA represents its own flagship brand (DUKE) alongside leading global brands such as Highlead, Kansai Special, Merrow, and Hikari. HCA serves garment manufacturers, leather and upholstery units, home textile producers, and embroidery/quilting businesses across India.

**Role Summary**

The Sales Executive will be responsible for driving revenue growth for HCA's Kolkata branch by identifying, developing, and managing customer relationships across the garment manufacturing, textile, and industrial sewing machinery segments. The role requires a proactive, target\-driven individual who can combine technical product knowledge with strong relationship management to grow HCA's market share in the East India region.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales \& Business Development**

● Identify and generate new business leads within garment manufacturing units, textile mills, leather/upholstery producers, and allied industries in and around Kolkata and the broader East India region.

● Conduct regular field visits to existing and prospective customers to understand their machinery requirements and recommend suitable HCA/DUKE products or partner brands (Highlead, Kansai Special, Merrow, etc.).

● Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets assigned by management.

● Prepare and deliver quotations, proposals, and product demonstrations to prospective clients.

**Account Management**

● Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing customers to ensure repeat business and long\-term loyalty.

● Follow up on after\-sales requirements including machine servicing, spare parts orders, and warranty support in coordination with the service team.

● Track customer feedback and machine performance issues, escalating to technical/service teams where needed.

**Market Intelligence \& Reporting**

● Monitor competitor activity, pricing trends, and new product developments in the industrial sewing machinery and textile automation space.

● Maintain accurate records of sales calls, customer interactions, and pipeline status using CRM/reporting tools or formats prescribed by the company.

● Submit regular sales reports, forecasts, and market feedback to the Branch/Regional Manager.

**Coordination**

● Liaise with the internal service, spares, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery, installation, and commissioning of machines at customer sites.

● Coordinate with the accounts team for invoicing, payment collection, and credit control as per company policy.

● Represent HCA at trade fairs, exhibitions, and industry events as required.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Education**

● Graduate in any discipline; a degree/diploma in Textile Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or Business Administration is an added advantage.

**Experience**

● 1–5 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in industrial machinery, textile/garment equipment, capital goods, or allied technical products.

● Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to learn technical products may also be considered for junior positions.

**Skills \& Competencies**

● Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali.

● Ability to understand and explain technical product features to non\-technical buyers.

● Self\-motivated with a target\-oriented approach and strong negotiation skills.

● Willingness to travel extensively within Kolkata and surrounding industrial clusters.

● Basic computer proficiency (MS Office, email, CRM tools).

● Valid driving license preferred (two\-wheeler/four\-wheeler).

**What HCA Offers**

● Opportunity to work with India's oldest and most established name in industrial sewing machinery.

● Exposure to a wide portfolio of global brands and cutting\-edge garment automation technology.

● Structured career growth path within a nationwide sales organization.

● Competitive fixed salary plus performance\-based incentives.

● Travel allowance and other applicable benefits as per company policy.

title: Junior Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Junior Full Stack Web Developer \| Ibn Batuttah Travel Info Pvt Ltd
 



  





 Location: Delhi NCR (Office\-based only \- NOT remote)
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Salary: Rs.25,000/month
 



 Experience: 1 \- 1\.5 years
 



 Immediate Joining
 



  





 IMPORTANT: This is an office\-based role in Delhi NCR. We do not offer remote or hybrid work. Please apply only if you are based in Delhi NCR or willing to relocate. This is a startup in its pre\-launch stage \- please read the full description before applying.
 



  





 About Us
 



  





 Ibn Batuttah is a travel technology startup currently in its pre\-launch stage. We are building a platform that connects mid\-size travel agents with the global travel market. We provide vendors with global hotel and flight inventory, a precision trip creator, and a complete dashboard to create and manage travel packages. Travellers can compare rates from multiple vendors, book hotels and flights, and build their own custom itineraries on our platform.
 



  





 We are a small core team working directly with the Founder to build something that does not exist anywhere else in the travel industry. This is not a corporate job with fixed processes and large teams. This is a startup where you will learn fast, work on real production code from Day 1, and have direct impact on the product.
 



  





 If you are someone who thrives in a structured corporate environment with defined hierarchies, this may not be the right fit. But if you are excited about building something from scratch and growing your skills rapidly, we would love to hear from you.
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 You will work as a junior developer under the guidance of our Senior Developer. Your primary role is to coordinate with the Senior Developer on a daily basis, take on delegated tasks, build UI components, fix bugs, test features, and work on smaller modules. All your work will be assigned, reviewed, and approved by the Senior Developer before deployment.
 



  





 While this is a support role, we value your ideas and creativity. If you see a better way to build something, a smarter solution, or have suggestions to improve the platform \- we want to hear it. Your input will be welcomed and considered. The best ideas can come from anyone on the team regardless of experience level. That said, final technical decisions rest with the Senior Developer and the Founder.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



  





 \- Coordinate with the Senior Developer daily to receive task assignments, discuss progress, and resolve blockers
 



 \- Build and maintain frontend components using React.js and Tailwind CSS based on Figma designs as assigned by the Senior Developer
 



 \- Develop and maintain backend APIs using Node.js and Express under the guidance of the Senior Developer
 



 \- Work with MySQL database \- write queries, manage schemas, and optimize performance as directed
 



 \- Integrate third\-party APIs (hotel booking APIs, flight APIs, payment gateways, maps) following the integration approach set by the Senior Developer
 



 \- Implement and maintain caching using Redis for improved performance
 



 \- Work on localization and multi\-language support for the platform as our platform serves users across multiple countries
 



 \- Fix bugs reported during testing and user feedback \- prioritised by the Senior Developer
 



 \- Submit all code for review by the Senior Developer before merging
 



 \- Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following the coding standards set by the Senior Developer
 



 \- Test features across browsers and devices before handing over to the Senior Developer for final review
 



 \- Participate in daily standups with the Senior Developer and weekly planning with the Founder
 



 \- Proactively update the Senior Developer on task status, estimated completion time, and any issues faced
 



 \- Share ideas, suggest improvements, and bring creative solutions to the table \- your perspective as a developer matters to us
 



  





 Tech Stack Required
 



  





 \- React.js (functional components, hooks, state management)
 



 \- Node.js with Express.js
 



 \- MySQL (queries, joins, indexing, schema design)
 



 \- Tailwind CSS (utility\-first styling, responsive design)
 



 \- Redis (basic caching, session management)
 



 \- Third\-party API integration (REST APIs, handling responses, error management)
 



 \- Git and GitHub (version control, branching, pull requests)
 



  





 Good to Have
 



  





 \- Experience with localization libraries (i18next, react\-intl, or similar)
 



 \- Understanding of JWT authentication and session management
 



 \- Experience with payment gateway integration (Razorpay, Stripe)
 



 \- Familiarity with Google Maps API or similar mapping services
 



 \- Knowledge of deployment (basic Linux, Nginx, PM2, or Docker)
 



 \- Understanding of responsive design and mobile\-first development
 



 \- Experience with any CMS or admin panel frameworks
 



  





 What We Need
 



  





 \- 1 to 1\.5 years of hands\-on development experience (internships count if you wrote production code)
 



 \- Working knowledge of the MERN stack \- you should be able to build a basic CRUD application independently
 



 \- Comfortable reading and understanding existing codebases \- you will be working on an existing platform, not building from scratch
 



 \- Ability to take instructions from the Senior Developer and execute them accurately without needing repeated explanations
 



 \- Ability to follow coding standards and write code that others can read and maintain
 



 \- Problem\-solving mindset \- you should be able to debug issues independently before escalating to the Senior Developer
 



 \- Creative thinking \- if you spot a better approach or have ideas to improve the product, we want you to speak up
 



 \- Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly as guided by the Senior Developer
 



 \- Good communication \- you need to coordinate with the Senior Developer clearly, ask questions when unsure, and provide regular progress updates
 



 \- Comfortable working in a startup environment \- no fixed processes, fast\-paced, and hands\-on
 



 \- Ego\-free attitude \- you will be the junior in the team. You need to be comfortable receiving feedback, corrections, and directions while also being confident enough to share your own ideas
 



  





 What You Get
 



  





 \- Salary: Rs.25,000/month
 



 \- Work alongside and learn from an experienced Senior Developer who will mentor and guide you daily
 



 \- Your ideas and creative suggestions are welcomed \- we believe good ideas can come from anyone in the team
 



 \- Hands\-on experience with real production code serving actual users
 



 \- Direct exposure to travel technology, API integrations, and marketplace dynamics
 



 \- Part of the core founding team
 



 \- Performance\-based salary review after 6 months
 



 \- Opportunity to grow into a mid\-level developer role as the company scales
 



  





 Please Do NOT Apply If
 



  





 \- You are looking for a remote or work\-from\-home position
 



 \- You are not based in Delhi NCR and not willing to relocate
 



 \- You are not comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment
 



 \- You expect large teams, fixed processes, and corporate structure from Day 1
 



 \- You only know HTML/CSS and have not worked with React or Node.js
 



 \- You cannot write a basic REST API independently
 



 \- You are not comfortable taking directions from a Senior Developer and working in a support role
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Send your resume to info@ibnbatuttah.com with the subject line "Junior Developer Application \- \[Your Name]" or apply directly through LinkedIn.
 



  





 Please include:
 



 \- Your resume
 



 \- Link to your GitHub profile or any live projects
 



 \- A brief note on your experience with React and Node.js
 



  





 Website: www.ibnbatuttah.com
 



  





 Ibn Batuttah Travel Info Pvt Ltd
 



 CIN: U79120BR2025PTC073082
 


* Delhi NCR, India

**Im Bereich "Accounting / Bookkeeping" bist du Teil der Finanzabteilung und baust ein Team für Buchhaltung, Abrechnung, Einkauf, Verkauf und Payment auf, welches der Geschäftsführung Report erstattet. Du bist verantwortlich für die finanziellen Dinge des Unternehmens und entwickelst proaktiv alle relevanten Prozesse und Abläufe.**
 Du koordinierst den Finanzbedarf für alle Teams, Projekte, Kampagnen oder Investments im Unternehmen und triffst Finanzentscheidungen mit deinem Finanz\-Team und/oder der Geschäftsleitung. Außerdem sorgst du für einen reibungsfreien Informationsfluss aller relevanten Finanzdaten / Metriken im Unternehmen sowie sauberes Reporting und Finanz\-Controlling.
   

  

* Deine Ziele


**Als Accounter / Bookkeeper erweiterst, trainierst und pflegst du stetig das Finanz\-Team. Du lenkst wichtige Aufgaben, schaffst Probleme im Finanz\-Bereich aus dem Weg und entwickelst eine Finanzplanung samt entsprechender Prozesse, KPIs und Controlling\-Instrumente, basierend auf den nächsten Meilensteinen des Unternehmens.**
 Als eines der Kernziele entwickelst du Prozessbeschreibungen und Dokumentationen rund um Finanzen, Buchhaltung sowie Lohn/Gehalt und dokumentierst die wichtigsten Prozesse, Systeme, Abläufe und Dokumente. **Du nimmst deine Aufgaben so wahr...**

title: Video Content Creator
description:
Vollzeit oder Freelance, m/w, 100% Remote
   

  

 Übersicht: Job für Video Content Creator
   

  

* Titel: Video Content Creator
* Firma: TrafficPrisma
* Website: www.trafficprisma.de
* Industrie: Consulting, Media, Marketing
* Verhältnis: Vollzeit, Freelance
* Arbeitszeiten: frei (zwischen 5\-20 Uhr), abgesehen von Meetings
* Ort: 100% Remote, Homeoffice bzw. Workation
* Sprache: Deutsch und Englisch
* Gehalt: Zwischen 30\.000 \- 60\.000 EUR / Jahr
* Verantwortung: Erstellung von Videos, Filmen, Trailern und anderem Video\-Content für die Website, digitale Produkte und soziale Medien; Entwicklung viraler Inhalte; Publishing und Postproduction
* Fähigkeiten: Kenntnisse in Videoproduktionstechniken; Fähigkeit, Geschichten zu erzählen; Kenntnisse in der Verwendung von Licht, Kameras und Ton sowie in den gängisten (AI) Video\-Tools
* Qualifikationen: Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Film, Media, Ton, Design oder einem ähnlichen Bereich; Sehr gutes Verständnis für Bildsprache, Schnitt, Formen, Proportionen, Farben, Ästhetik
* Beschreibung


**Als "Video Content Creator" entwickelst Filme, Videos und Trailer für alle Kanäle und Zwecke. Dies können Vlogs, Launch\-Trailer, Trainings\-Tutorials oder Screencapture\-Aufnahmen für Kunden, Interessenten oder Mitarbeiter sein. Du begleitest Kollegen auf Reisen im In\- und Ausland und übernimmst Planung und Umsetzung.**
 Du bist für Anschaffung, Pflege und den Transport des gesamten Video\-Equipments zuständig, planst selbstständig Video\-Locations, organisierst ggf. notwendiges Video\-Footage\-Material sowie Sounds zur Vertonung und übernimmst alle Schritte der Video\-Produktion, vom Scripting, über die Aufnahmen, visuelles Storytelling, Vertonung und Abmischung.
   

  

* Deine Ziele


**Dein oberstes Ziel als Video\-Content\-Creator ist es, das gesamte Leben und Arbeiten aller Teams und Mitarbeiter bei TrafficPrisma auf eine emotionale, spannende, kurzweilige und sympathische Weise in Videos zu visualisieren. Kurz gesagt, du erhältst die Aufgabe übertragen, einen Superbrand zu formen und in Youtube aufzubauen.**
 Als ein weiteres Kernziel produzierst und emotionalisierst du alle Arten von Videos, Filmen und Trailern, die mit Vertrieb, Verkauf, Marketing, Branding oder Listbuilding zu tun haben. Storytelling und das Komponieren typischer "Vblog\-Videos" sind die großen Themen. Du visualisierst das gedankliche Universum von TrafficPrisma in Form exzellenter Videos.
   

  

**Du nimmst deine Aufgaben so wahr...**
**✓** 
 dass alle in deinem Bereich anfallenden Aufgaben sachlich richtig, zügig, qualitativ, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich erledigt werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die spezifizierten Videoziele hinsichtlich Reichweite, Fanaufbau und Bekanntheitsgrad unserer Marke bei Kunden erreicht werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die Zahl der A\-Kunden für unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen erhöht und diese an das Unternehmen gebunden werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die View/Play\-Zahl stetig vergrößert wird, Beziehungen zu Kunden gepflegt und das Involvement in die Videos vertieft werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die Videos den Richtlinien des Unternehmens, dem "Customer Avatar" und dem "Attraktiven Charakter" entsprechen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass in den Videos, Filmen und Screencaptures die für den Zuschauer wichtigsten Informationen einfach zu verstehen / zu nutzen sind;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass jede Art von Video\-Content, seien es Filme, Trailer, Vblogs, Trainings, Screencaptures etc., einen attraktiven, professionellen, hochwertigen und positiven Eindruck machen und stets Call\-to\-Actions aufweisen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass der Aufbau des gesamten Film\- und Videomaterials dem Stand der aktuellen Video\-Schnitt\-Psychologie und Vertonung entsprechen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die vorgegebenen Kostenbudgets sowie die festgelegten sachlichen und terminlichen Vorgaben jederzeit eingehalten werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass Vorgesetzte stets über den Stand der Entwicklung bei Videoprojekten oder außergewöhnlichen Vorkommnissen unterrichtet sind;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass Betriebsgeheimnisse und die Vertraulichkeit von Themen, die nicht allgemein zugänglich sind, jederzeit gewahrt bleiben;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die späteren Betrachter der Videos schnell, einfach und vollständig den Wert unserer Produkte oder Angebote erkennen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass Layout, Schnitt und Aufbau der Videos an die Corporate Identity von TrafficPrisma angepasst sind und die Marke unterstreichen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass der Informationsfluss mit anderen Stellen reibungslos funktioniert und insgesamt eine gute Zusammenarbeit gewährleistet ist.
   

  

* Deine Aufgaben


**Deine Aufgaben Als Video\-Content\-Creator Sind Vielfältig Und Müssen Sich Nicht Direkt Nur Auf Deine Position Beziehen. Vielmehr Sind Sie Im Kontext Deiner Position Sowie Ggf. Deines Teams Zu Verstehen, Welches Du Führst Oder Mit Welchem Du Kollaborativ Arbeitest:**
**✓** 
 Ausarbeitung von Richtlinien, Checklisten, Trainingsunterlagen, Vorlagen und Video\-Bausteinen für den Bereich Video\-Content\-Creation;
   

  

**✓** 
 Übersetzen der Produkteigenschaften in Videotutorials, Imagevideos, Trailer, Webinare \& Screenncaptures mit Fokus auf Kundennutzen;
   

  

**✓** 
 Konzept\- und Drehbucherstellung im Rahmen von Kampagnen, Launches oder Sonderaktionen sowie zielsichere Entwicklung von Ideen;
   

  

**✓** 
 Aufnahme bzw. Dreh der Videos und anschließende Nachbearbeitung mit Vertonung, Schnitt, Verfeinerung und Veröffentlichung / Einbindung;
   

  

**✓** 
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Teams und Kollegen aus den Bereichen der Redaktion, Marketing \& Verkauf für koordinierte Kampagnen;
   

  

**✓** 
 Konzepterstellung und Produktion von Bild\- und Videoformaten in Social Media, insbesondere YouTube, um Bekanntheit zu steigern;
   

  

**✓** 
 Reisebereitschaft als Begleitung der Geschäftsführung, eines Teams oder einzelner Kollegen für Videoaufnahmen in anderen Locations;
   

  

**✓** 
 Handling aller möglichen Kameraformate wie Digitalkamera, Spiegelreflex, Drohnen, Gopros sowie Aufbau, Abbau, Befestigung etc.;
   

  

**✓** 
 Organisation und Pflege des gesamten Video\-Equipments wie Mikrofone, Akkus, Linsen, Stative, Objektive, Schutzverpackungen, Kabel etc.;
   

  

**✓** 
 Verantwortung der gesamten Produktion von Filmen und Videos, von der redaktionellen Planung, Aufzeichnung bis zur Finalisierung;
   

  

**✓** 
 Schulung interner Teams oder Kollegen im Umgang mit Aufnahme\- und/oder Wiedergabegeräten sowie ggf. Einweisung;
   

  

**✓** 
 Pflege und Wartung des anvertrauten Equipments sowie Beratung von Teams und Geschäftsführung bei neuem Equipment;
   

  

**✓** 
 Erstellung von Ablaufplänen, Storyboards und Aufnahmeplänen für Dreharbeiten sowie ggf. Organisation von Locations;
   

  

**✓** 
 Dokumentieren und archivieren des produzierten Roh\- und Endmaterials sowie Aufbau \& Pflege einer internen Film\-Footage\-Bibliothek;
   

  

**✓** 
 Sehr gutes Gefühl für Musik, Vertonungen, Proportionen, Storytelling, Farben, Abfolgen, Rhythmen, Harmonien und Schnitt;
   

  

**✓** 
 Dreh von Studio\-Formaten, On\-Location, How\-To\-Videos, Reportagen, Salesvideos, Webinare, Ttrailern, Präsentationen etc.;
   

  

**✓** 
 Selbstständiges Planen, umsetzen, aufzeichnen und veröffentlichen von Interviews mit externen Experten, Unternehmern und Influencern;
   

  

**✓** 
 Aufnahme und Recording von Screencapture\-Videos sowie einsprechen oder nachvertonen der Tonspur mit anschließendem Upload;
   

  

**✓** 
 Schnitt von Videobeiträgen aus Agenturmaterial (Stock Footage) und selbst gedrehtem Footage für alle Bereiche des Unternehmens.
   

  

* Dein Profil


**Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Bereich Video\-Content\-Creator. Zudem solltest du mit Videosoftware vertraut sein und dich mit Psychologie, Storytelling und Bildsprache auskennen. Du bist ein kreativer und emotionaler Videodesigner, der gerne visuell denkt und nimmst die Herausforderung an, das Leben bei TrafficPrisma auf hohem Niveau filmisch zu visualisieren und zu dokumentieren.**
 Du Bist Eine Zuverlässige Person, Die Spaß An Videos Sowie Storytelling Hat Und Zudem Selbstständig Und Unabhängig Arbeiten (und Denken) Kann. Die Obere Liste Deiner Aufgaben Überfordert Dich Nicht, Sondern Du Betrachtest Sie Als Leitfaden Für Die Nächsten Jahre Und Bist Langfristig Dabei. Und Du Kannst Dich Klar Mit Folgenden Wesenszügen Identifizieren:
   

  

**✓** 
 jederzeit umgänglich, freundlich und kommunikativ in Gesprächen
   

  

**✓** 
 emotional kontrolliert, wenn es hektisch und/oder stressig wird
   

  

**✓** 
 offen \& locker, ohne jedoch die Ernsthaftigkeit der Arbeit zu verlieren
   

  

**✓** 
 ausbalanciert, hilfsbereit und mit sozialer \& emotionaler Kompetenz
   

  

**✓** 
 jederzeit lernfähig, lernbereit und wissbegierig bei neuen Themen
   

  

**✓** 
 strategisch, planerisch, methodisch, klar und langfristig denkend
   

  

**✓** 
 inneren positiven Dialog, dankbar dem Leben gegenüber \& geerdet
   

  

**✓** 
 motiviert, vorbildlich und fleißig an neue Aufgaben heran gehend
   

  

**✓** 
 strukturiert, zuverlässig, sauber und qualitativ in der Arbeitsweise
   

  

 Um die Aufgaben optimal lösen zu können, solltest du dich auskennen mit Videoaufnahmen, Videoschnitt, Bearbeitung \& Video\-Equipment sowie eine Affinität für Youtube, Verkauf und visuelles Storytelling haben.
   

  

 Du bist vertraut mit Adobe Premiere, Camtasia und kannst dich schnell in neue Cloud\-Apps wie Freshsales, Kajabi, Vimeo, Trello oder andere Tools des Techstacks einarbeiten sowie selbstständig Remote arbeiten.
   

  

* Unsere Leistungen


**Zuerst bieten wir dir das Ende des Hamsterrads wie in herkömmlichen Bürojobs an! Als reines Internet\-Business ermöglichen wir dir zu 100% Remote von den verschiedensten Orten der Erde aus zu arbeiten. Oder auch traditionell vom Home\-Office oder Coworking\-Space.**
 Doch wir bieten dir noch etwas anderes, dass mehr Wert ist als geografische oder bürokratische Freiheit: die Teilnahme an und den Aufbau einer Vision die größer ist als wir alle zusammen: Wir sind dabei, einen Unternehmens\-Prototypen in der Cloud aufzubauen und damit etwas so komplexes wie Unternehmensaufbau so easy wie Blogging zu machen.
   

  

 Dabei legen wir bei unseren Scrum\-basierten Remote\-Teams hohen Wert auf Kommunikation, Engagement und Effizienz. Alle unsere Prozesse sind präzise dokumentiert. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese weiter optimiert werden und (neuen) Mitarbeitern, Partnern und Kunden im C.O.R.E. Framework sowie TrafficPrisma\-Account zur Verfügung stehen.

 Du erlebst ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld mit vielen tollen Kollegen.
   

  

**✓** 
 Du tauchst in eine kreative, lernbereite sowie offene Atmosphäre ein.
   

  

**✓** 
 Du erhältst viel Raum für eigene Gestaltungen, Verbesserungen \& Ideen.
   

  

**✓** 
 Du wirst jederzeit Unterstützung erfahren, um dich weiterzuentwickeln.
   

  

**✓** 
 Du hast freie Zeiteinteilung \& kannst nach deinem Biorythmus arbeiten.

 Du kannst weltweit Kollegen besuchen \& temporär im Ausland arbeiten.

Ebenfalls gehört die stete Sicherung der Unternehmensqualität, Prozesslandkarte sowie des gesamten Content\-, Produkt\- und Dienstleistungs\-Outputs zu deinen Aufgaben. **Als Audit / QM\-Manager bist du Mitglied der Führungsebene und stellst über Maßnahmen sicher, dass die interne wie externe Servicequalität systematisch gesteigert und verbessert wird. Außerdem setzt du dich dafür ein, dass unsere Organisation eine tiefe Kundenorientierung sowie überragenden Support verinnerlichen und leben.**
 Als ein Kernziel übernimmst du intern die Funktion eines Dienstleisters. Bei allen Fragen zum Qualitätsmanagement kannst du hinzugezogen und/oder konsultiert werden. Du bist eine Art "Übersetzer" für komplexe Sachverhalte und optimierst alles, was zu mehr Qualität, Geschwindigkeit, Durchfluss, Automation, Klarheit, Wert und Kundenzufriedenheit führt.

**✓** 
 dass alle in deinem Bereich anfallenden Aufgaben sachlich richtig, zügig, termingerecht, kompetent und wirtschaftlich erledigt werden;
   

  

**✓**

**✓**

**✓**

**✓**

title: Operations Manager – Pathology
description:
Job Description – Operations Manager – PathologyPosition

**Operations Manager – Pathology**

Department : Operations

Location: Thane,Maharastra (As per Business Requirement)

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 5–8 Years

Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Life Sciences, Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT), Biotechnology, Healthcare Management, or a related field.
* MBA in Operations, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, or a related discipline is preferred.

Job Summary

The **Operations Manager – Pathology** is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end operations of the diagnostic business, ensuring efficient laboratory operations, exceptional service delivery, operational excellence, and compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The role involves managing laboratories, collection centres, logistics, manpower, customer service, inventory, and process optimization while supporting business growth and expansion across multiple locations.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership, operational management, and stakeholder coordination skills, with proven experience in diagnostic laboratories or hospital operations.

Key Responsibilities1\. Operations Management

* Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of central laboratories, collection centres, satellite laboratories, and onsite diagnostic units.
* Ensure seamless execution of pre\-analytical, analytical, and post\-analytical laboratory processes.
* Monitor sample collection, transportation, accessioning, processing, reporting, and report dispatch activities.
* Ensure adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT), quality standards, and service\-level agreements.
* Maintain uninterrupted laboratory operations across all assigned locations.

2\. Process Improvement

* Develop, implement, and periodically review Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Standardize operational processes across all laboratory locations.

3\. Quality \& Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with NABL standards, Biomedical Waste Management Rules, and all applicable statutory regulations.
* Coordinate internal quality audits, external assessments, and accreditation activities.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.
* Promote quality management systems and patient safety initiatives.

4\. Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead, mentor, and motivate laboratory, logistics, collection centre, and operations teams.
* Plan manpower deployment, shift scheduling, and workforce productivity.
* Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, induction, training, and competency development of operational staff.
* Conduct performance reviews and foster a culture of accountability and continuous learning.

5\. Customer \& Client Management

* Ensure prompt resolution of customer concerns, complaints, and operational issues.
* Maintain strong relationships with hospitals, corporate clients, collection centres, franchise partners, and referring physicians.
* Monitor service quality and customer satisfaction through regular feedback and service reviews.
* Ensure consistent delivery of high\-quality diagnostic services.

6\. Logistics \& Supply Chain Management

* Oversee sample transportation and logistics to ensure timely and safe movement of specimens.
* Monitor inventory levels of reagents, consumables, laboratory supplies, and operational materials.
* Coordinate with Procurement and vendors to ensure uninterrupted availability of critical supplies.
* Minimize stock\-outs and optimize inventory utilization.

7\. Business Expansion \& Project Support

* Support the operational setup of new laboratories, collection centres, franchisees, and onsite diagnostic projects.
* Participate in site assessments, infrastructure planning, and operational readiness activities.
* Coordinate with Project Management and cross\-functional teams for successful implementation of expansion projects.
* Ensure smooth operational transition during new facility launches.

8\. Financial \& Cost Management

* Monitor operational budgets and ensure efficient utilization of resources.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality and service standards.
* Control operational expenses related to manpower, logistics, inventory, and facility management.

The Project management specialist will be responsible for coaching and mentoring Core Team Leaders that are assigned to projects who reside outside of the PMO.

  

#### **III. RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Work with Project Teams in the completion of product development plans to ensure product availability in alignment with the commercialization plans.
* Work on development of integrated business plans and subsequent detailed commercialization plans for the product that incorporates the identified markets and balances a global roll\-out to maximize success of the product.
* Plan, schedule, and control project activities to fulfill project objectives and satisfy project / product requirements. Ensure team deliverables are in compliance with the company’s product development and quality processes.
* Work on project budget, cost and profit targets to meet established return on investment goals.
* Develop/maintain strong relationships with functional senior leaders to drive success of the team.
* Drive a high\-performance culture by fostering innovation, personal accountability, and a commitment to results.
* Provide structured thinking to the project team on the overall approach and delegate tasks as appropriate based on expectations established for members of the team.
* Support team members to ensure process adherence and effective project management, utilizing best practice project management skills.
* Collaborate with the team for appropriate decision making through strong judgment and the ability to analyze options and implications.
* Demonstrate product development process knowledge through delivery of high quality and high impact deliverables that meet the market’s needs.
* Provide feedback to functional departments during the company’s annual planning process on product development requirements, including financial and human resources.
#### **IV. REQUIREMENTS**


* A minimum of 3\-5 years’ experience with a strong track record in driving implementation of complex product development projects, preferably in the medical device industry.
* Bachelors Degree required.MS, MBA, Engineering Degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* PMP certification preferred.
* Knowledge of a Regulatory environment, Medical Device environment preferred (Coursework/experience in 21CFR, QSR 830, ISO 13485:2003, ISO 14971, Risk Management, etc.).
* Proven ability to manage and lead multi\-functional teams to drive success of a project.
* Experience working in product development/commercialization preferred.
* Ability to focus and drive ongoing organizational assessment to identify gaps/opportunities relative to the product development and commercialization processes.
* Serve as a change agent with passion, high\-energy, and a results oriented creative and analytical mind with the ability to manage critical situations.
* Proven ability to collaborate and work effectively with others in a dynamic matrix environment that includes interactions with multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience with project management tools and skills; with knowledge of process and project planning best practices.
* Proven ability to develop a team culture that leads to ongoing excellence and achievement of goals.
* Proven ability to manage extensive communications both up and down in the organization to keep key stakeholders appropriately engaged and informed to drive success of a project.
* Ability to balance planning and project focus with the needs for flexibility to ensure successful execution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex information succinctly to executive leaders.
* Strong influence management skills.
* Business acumen; ability to think from an overall “best for the business” perspective.
* Strong analytical, planning, organization and time management skills to effectively execute project plans and budgets and manage multiple priorities.
* Effective decision\-making skills: ability to negotiate and balance decisions and priorities across diverse needs of multiple constituencies. Makes timely decisions in the face of risk and uncertainty.
* Demonstrate customer focus in all interactions. Demonstrated ability to understand customer requirements and incorporate them into business decisions.
**Company Profile: Hollister Incorporated**
===========================================


##### **Overview:**


Hollister Incorporated is an independent, employee\-owned company that develops, manufactures, and markets a wide range of healthcare products and services worldwide. The company’s mission is to make life more rewarding and dignified for individuals who use its products and services. At Hollister, the focus is on the dignity of every individual, and the company is dedicated to helping people navigate their healthcare journeys with respect, compassion, and innovation.

  

##### **Mission:**


Hollister’s mission is grounded in the principles of **Dignity**, **Integrity**, **Service**, and **Stewardship**, which guide every aspect of its operations. These principles ensure that Hollister makes a meaningful impact on the lives of those who use its products:

  

* + **Dignity**: Respecting all individuals, regardless of their background or circumstances.
	+ **Integrity**: Operating with honesty and transparency in everything the company does.
	+ **Service**: Providing exceptional customer care and support with compassion and humility.
	+ **Stewardship**: Protecting the long\-term health and sustainability of the company and its mission.
##### **History \& Founding:**


* + **Founded**: 1921
	+ Founder: John Dickinson Schneider
	+ **Headquarters**: Libertyville, Illinois, USA
	+ **Industry**: Medical Products Manufacturing
	+ **Website**: www.hollister.com
**Company Type**: Independent, employee\-owned organization **Employee Count**: **1,001 \- 5,000 employees globally**

  

**Locations:** Hollister operates globally with a presence in several regions across the world. Some key locations include:

  

* + **North America**: Headquartered in Libertyville, Illinois, USA
	+ **Europe**: Multiple offices and manufacturing sites in various European countries
	+ **Asia\-Pacific**: Locations in several countries, including **India**, China, Japan, and Australia
	+ **Latin America**: Operations in key markets
##### **Medical Devices \& Products:**

  

Hollister offers a broad range of **medical devices** designed to meet the healthcare needs of individuals with specific medical conditions. The company’s product portfolio focuses on **ostomy care**, **continence care**, and **critical care**, all aimed at improving the lives of patients who face challenges in these areas.


##### **Main Product Categories:**

  

* **Ostomy Care:**
	+ **Ostomy Pouches**: Hollister provides various types of ostomy pouches, designed for individuals who have undergone ostomy surgeries (colostomy, ileostomy, or urostomy). These pouches help manage waste elimination while maintaining comfort and skin health.
		- **One\-Piece Pouches**: Designed for convenience and simplicity, these pouches are attached directly to the skin barrier.
		- **Two\-Piece Pouches**: Offer flexibility by allowing the pouch to be detached from the barrier for easier cleaning and disposal.
	+ **Skin Barriers \& Flanges**: Hollister’s skin barriers and flanges provide a secure and comfortable fit between the skin and the ostomy pouch. These products help protect the skin from irritation and leakage.
	+ **Skin Care Products**: Specialized products such as wipes, creams, and sprays are available to protect skin around the stoma and reduce irritation caused by wearing an ostomy pouch.
##### **2\. Continence Care:**


* **Urinary Management**: Hollister offers a range of products designed to help individuals manage urinary incontinence and other urinary conditions, including **catheters** and **drainage bags**. These products are essential for people who need assistance with bladder control.
	+ **Intermittent Catheters**: Used for patients who require a catheter to empty their bladder.
	+ **Leg Bags and Drainage Systems**: For patients who need longer\-term urinary drainage, Hollister provides a variety of options for comfort and safety.
* **Fecal Incontinence**: Hollister also provides products for individuals dealing with fecal incontinence. This includes **fecal management systems** that are designed to contain and manage stool in a comfortable and hygienic manner.
  
##### **3\. Critical Care:**


* **Wound Care**: Hollister produces a range of **advanced wound care products**, including dressings and healing systems. These products help promote the body's natural healing process for chronic wounds, burns, and surgical incisions.
	+ **Dressings**: Designed for various types of wounds, these dressings help keep the wound moist, prevent infection, and support healing.
	+ **Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT)**: A therapeutic treatment used to promote healing by applying controlled negative pressure to the wound.
* **Surgical Products**: The company also manufactures surgical products used in critical care settings, including **surgical drapes** and **infection prevention products**.
  
##### **Certifications \& Compliance:**

  

Hollister's medical devices are designed and manufactured to meet international quality standards. Some of the key certifications include:

  

* **ISO 13485:2016** (Quality Management Systems for Medical Devices)
* **ISO 14971:2019** (Risk Management for Medical Devices)
* **FDA Compliance (21 CFR Part 820\)**: Hollister complies with FDA regulations for medical device manufacturing.
* **CE Marking**: For products sold in the European Union, Hollister's devices carry the CE symbol or CE 0050 symbol, indicating conformity with EU health, safety, and environmental requirements.
  

##### **Global Business Services (GBS) in India:**

  

The **Hollister Global Business Services India Pvt Ltd** is a key part of Hollister’s global operations, supporting the company's functions in areas such as finance, IT, HR, and project management. Located in **Gurgaon, Haryana**, this office started its operations in **2023** and has quickly grown to a team of **90\+ employees**. The team provides essential business services that help streamline operations and deliver high\-quality service to customers worldwide.

* + **Finance Support**: Handling financial operations and supporting global financial planning.
	+ **Human Resources**: Assisting with HR functions, including recruitment, employee services, and payroll management.
	+ **IT Services**: Providing critical IT support and solutions for global teams.
	+ **Project Management**: Supporting various project management activities for product development and commercialization.

* Additionally, Hollister operates a **manufacturing plant in Haryana**, further strengthening its presence in the region and supporting its commitment to meeting the healthcare needs of the global market.

##### **Why Choose Hollister?**

  

* **Employee\-Owned**: As an employee\-owned company, Hollister fosters a strong sense of accountability and collaboration among its employees.

Job Description – Resource Augmentation Trainee

**Position:** Resource Augmentation Trainee  
**Department:** Resource Augmentation / Talent Acquisition

**Location:** Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year (Freshers can apply)

About the Company

Clock Edge Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a technology\-driven engineering services company specializing in Resource Augmentation, Engineering Services, Project Development, and Technology Training. We support leading organizations across IT, Embedded Systems, Semiconductor, Automotive, Manufacturing, AI, and Digital Engineering by providing high\-quality technical talent and project execution services.

Position Summary

The Resource Augmentation Trainee will be responsible for supporting the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle by sourcing, screening, coordinating, and tracking candidates for client requirements. The role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in technical recruitment, client coordination, vendor management, and workforce planning.

Key ResponsibilitiesRequirement Analysis

* Understand client job requirements, technical skills, experience, budget, notice period, and location.
* Analyze job descriptions and identify suitable sourcing strategies.
* Coordinate with the Resource Augmentation Manager regarding demand priorities.

Candidate Sourcing

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, internal databases, colleges, and professional networks.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future requirements.
* Generate quality profiles within defined turnaround times.

Candidate Screening

* Conduct initial HR screening to evaluate:
* Technical skills
* Experience
* Communication skills
* Salary expectations
* Notice period
* Relocation and work preferences
* Verify candidate information before profile submission.

Recruitment Coordination

* Schedule interviews with candidates and clients.
* Coordinate interview logistics and communicate interview schedules.
* Collect interview feedback from candidates and clients.
* Follow up until interview completion.

Candidate Engagement

* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Coordinate offer discussions, documentation, onboarding, and joining formalities.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience.

Recruitment Reporting

* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment reports.
* Update sourcing activities, interview status, closures, and pipeline reports.

Vendor \& Client Support

* Coordinate with recruitment vendors and sourcing partners when required.
* Support client communication for profile submissions and status updates.
* Ensure compliance with client submission guidelines and timelines.

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation abilities.
* Basic understanding of recruitment and staffing processes.
* Ability to understand technical job descriptions.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn and major job portals (Naukri, Foundit, etc.) is an advantage.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Willingness to work in a target\-driven environment.

Educational Qualification

* MBA (HR), PGDM (HR)
* BBA
* BE/B.Tech
* Any Bachelor's or Master's degree with an interest in Talent Acquisition or Human Resources

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of IT, Engineering, Semiconductor, Embedded Systems, Manufacturing, or Automotive hiring.
* Basic understanding of recruitment metrics and applicant tracking systems.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Professional attitude with a strong willingness to learn.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of job requirements handled.
* Number of candidate profiles sourced.
* Number of quality profile submissions.
* Interview conversion ratio.
* Candidate joining ratio.
* Time\-to\-submit (TAT) compliance.
* Recruitment tracker accuracy.
* Candidate database growth.
* Candidate response and engagement rate.
* Client satisfaction with profile quality.

Career Growth

Successful trainees will have opportunities to progress into roles such as:

* Resource Augmentation Executive
* Resource Augmentation Specialist
* Senior Resource Augmentation Specialist
* Talent Acquisition Consultant
* Team Lead – Resource Augmentation
* Account Manager – Staffing Services

Why Join Clock Edge Technologies?

* Opportunity to work with leading IT, Semiconductor, Embedded Systems, Automotive, and Manufacturing organizations.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end technical recruitment and resource augmentation.
* Hands\-on learning in client management, vendor coordination, and workforce planning.
* Structured career progression and continuous learning opportunities.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated resume to:

**Email:** info@clkedge.com  
**Contact:** \+91 9884215701

description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Role Purpose**

The Talent Acquisition Manager is responsible for leading and delivering end\-to\-end recruitment strategies that enable the organization to attract, engage, and hire high\-quality talent across engineering, projects, procurement, construction, corporate, and leadership functions. The role partners closely with business leaders to align workforce planning with business objectives while ensuring an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute talent acquisition strategies aligned with business growth and workforce plans.
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment from requisition through onboarding.
* Partner with business leaders on workforce planning and hiring priorities.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and hard\-to\-fill roles.
* Drive sourcing through direct search, referrals, social media and agency partnerships.
* Lead, coach and develop the Talent Acquisition team.
* Ensure recruitment compliance, governance and process excellence.
* Manage recruitment vendors and external search partners.
Track and report recruitment KPIs and hiring outcomes.  
* 

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Workforce Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Leadership Hiring
* Employer Branding
* Talent Market Intelligence
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Team Leadership
* Process Improvement

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor degree in HR, Business or related discipline.
* 10–15\+ years of Talent Acquisition experience.
* Experience leading recruitment teams in a high\-volume environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Experience with ATS/CRM platforms and recruitment technologies.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
**1\. Front Desk \& Visitor Management**

* Greet visitors respectfully and ensure a positive first impression
* Arrange tea/coffee for guests and visitors when required
* Manage visitor entry, issue visitor passes, and maintain visitor logs
* Inform concerned departments/employees about visitor arrivals
* Ensure reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times
* Maintain all the plants and front Temple properly.

**2\. Telephonic \& Communication Management**

* Receive, screen, and route incoming calls professionally
* Take accurate messages and ensure timely communication
* Handle general inquiries and provide correct information or redirection
* Manage official email inboxes related to front\-desk communication

**3\. Hospitality Management**

* Ensure timely distribution of drinking water bottles to all employees
* Provide tea/coffee to employees as instructed
* Maintain basic hospitality standards at the reception area

**4\. Administrative Support**

* Maintain records, registers, and basic documentation
* Assist in data entry, filing, scanning, and photocopying
* Coordinate meeting room bookings and basic arrangements
* Support HR/Admin team with joining formalities, ID cards, attendance coordination, etc.

**5\. Coordination \& Support**

* Support courier, dispatch, inward–outward, and visitor’s register maintenance
* Maintain and update daily checklist of housekeeping staff
* Report facility, safety, or visitor issues to the concerned person

**6\. Compliance \& Confidentiality**

* Follow company policies, security protocols, and confidentiality norms
* Ensure adherence to safety and emergency procedures
* Handle sensitive information responsibly

**Authority \& Accountability** 

* Handle and redirect calls, visitors, and inquiries as per company protocols
* Issue visitor passes and maintain front\-office records responsibly
* Coordinate with internal departments, security, housekeeping, and vendors for smooth front\-office operations
* Escalate matters related to security, safety, facilities, or complaints to Admin/HR/Management
* Maintain confidentiality of information and ensure compliance with company policies
* Be accountable for professional conduct, accuracy of records, timely communication, and overall front\-office efficiency

**Skills \& Competencies** 

* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Professional etiquette with a customer\-focused approach
* Basic computer proficiency (MS Office, email, office equipment)
* Good organizational, coordination, and multitasking ability
* Attention to detail with accurate record\-keeping skills
* Problem\-solving ability and calm behavior under pressure
* Integrity, confidentiality, and reliability

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 

* Quality of visitor handling and first\-impression feedback
* Call management efficiency and message accuracy
* Timeliness and effectiveness of communication and coordination
* Accuracy and maintenance of front\-office records and registers
* Adherence to professional conduct, grooming, and policies
* Punctuality, attendance, and overall responsiveness

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to: HR Manager
* Coordinates with: All departments, security, housekeeping

description:
**Overview of 66degrees** 




 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
 



 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




 66degrees Software Engineers within the Innovation team are catalysts for future growth. You will leverage your strong development foundation to explore emerging technologies, identify new opportunities, and rapidly prototype high\-impact "accelerators" and minimum viable products (MVPs) for our clients. Partnering with cross\-functional experts in AI, data, and cloud engineering, you will move beyond mission\-critical application delivery to actively shape the next generation of intelligent enterprise solutions. This role is for a highly motivated and exploratory individual passionate about turning complex challenges into clear, quantifiable outcomes and driving new value for the business.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end full stack applications, combining scalable backend systems with intuitive frontend interfaces.
* Build and manage data\-heavy backend systems, with a strong focus on data engineering, data warehousing, and data modeling.
* Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python to ingest and process data from structured and unstructured sources into cloud data platforms.
* Create responsive and high\-performance user interfaces using React.js, enabling rich data visualizations and seamless user interactions.
* Work with Big Data technologies and cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) to ensure efficient data processing at scale.
* Leverage cloud platforms (GCP) and services like Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, or equivalent to build and deploy scalable microservices.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (AI, Data, Cloud, Product) to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (TDD), and best engineering practices to ensure high\-quality and reliable software delivery.
* Experiment with and implement AI/ML and Generative AI use cases, contributing to rapid prototyping of MVPs and accelerators.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and contribute to innovation\-driven product development within the organization.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3–8 years of experience in full stack development with strong expertise in Python (backend) and React.js (frontend).
* Hands\-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, and processing large\-scale datasets (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake).
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and data architecture principles.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS/Azure acceptable) and deploying scalable applications.
* Familiarity with Big Data ecosystems and distributed data processing frameworks is a plus.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and backend system design.
* Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Exposure to or strong interest in AI/ML and Generative AI technologies (LLMs, prompt engineering, etc.) is highly desirable.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and analytical thinking, with the ability to work on ambiguous and evolving requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
* Demonstrated learning mindset, adaptability, and curiosity, with exposure to diverse technologies or domains being a plus.



 We value candidates who demonstrate a balance of
 **technical depth (data/backend)** 
 and
 **breadth (frontend, AI, product thinking)** 
 , along with a strong attitude and willingness to learn.
 



*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.* 




  





**AI Transparency \& Disclosure** 




 As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

* Implement HR policies aligned with labour laws and company standards

**5\. Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain employee records, disciplinary cases, and compliance documentation

**Education** 



* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in HR, Labour Law, or Industrial Relations

* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance

* Stakeholder management
