**Human Resources Generalist** 




  





**About Cosmicport** 




 Cosmicport is a space\-tech startup developing methalox rocket propulsion and launch systems from Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. We operate a cryogenic propulsion test facility and are building a team of engineers and operators working at the frontier of Indian private spaceflight. We are looking for an HR professional who can build people systems from the ground up in a fast\-moving, engineering\-driven environment.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 You will own the full people function for a growing deep\-tech team: recruitment, onboarding, statutory compliance, policy, performance frameworks, and culture. This is a builder role — you will set up processes where none exist, and you will work directly with the founders on organizational decisions.
 



  





**Educational Qualification:** 




 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. MBA/PGDM with HR specialization preferred. Certification in labor law or statutory compliance (e.g., PF/ESI/POSH\-related courses) is an added advantage.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Talent Acquisition** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for engineering, operations, and support roles: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closing.
* Build sourcing pipelines for niche aerospace talent (propulsion, aerodynamics, avionics, manufacturing etc), including outreach into ISRO/DRDO\-adjacent networks, premier engineering institutes, and industry referrals.
* Maintain structured hiring documentation: JDs, interview scorecards, and candidate trackers.



**Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle** 



* Run structured onboarding covering documentation, facility safety induction, confidentiality/IP agreements, and role expectations.
* Maintain complete and audit\-ready employee records, contracts, and exit documentation.



**Statutory Compliance \& Payroll Support** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labor law: Shops \& Establishments registration, PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, POSH Act obligations, and contract labor requirements where applicable.
* Coordinate with external counsel and accountants on employment contracts, payroll inputs, and filings.



**Policy \& Performance** 



* Draft and maintain the employee handbook, leave policy, code of conduct, travel policy, and facility conduct rules aligned with a safety\-critical test environment.
* Administer review cycles, probation confirmations, and performance documentation in coordination with functional leads.



**Culture \& Employee Relations** 



* Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances and workplace concerns, escalating to founders where necessary.
* Support team communication, engagement, and retention in a demanding, high\-ownership environment.



  





**Required Qualities:** 



* 2–5 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a startup, manufacturing, engineering services, or industrial environment.
* Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance (PF/ESI/POSH at minimum).
* Demonstrated end\-to\-end recruitment ownership, ideally for technical/engineering roles.
* Strong written English; ability to draft policies, contracts inputs, and formal communication independently.
* Fluency in English; willingness to be based full\-time in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.
* High discretion — comfort handling confidential information in an IP\-sensitive, export\-control\-aware company.



  





**Preferred Qualities:** 



* Experience hiring in aerospace, defence, automotive, or heavy engineering sectors.
* Exposure to HRMS/ATS tools (Keka, greytHR, or similar).
* Experience setting up HR functions from scratch (0→1\).



  





**Location** 
 : On\-site — Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, India
 



**Experience** 
 Level: 2\-5 years
 



**Compensation** 
 : Competitive, aligned with experience and ownership level
 



  





 Apply by sending your resume here, or to contact@cosmicport.com.

**The Opportunity:** 




 PureSpectrum is seeking a proactive, detail\-oriented, and organized individual to join the People \+ Culture (P\+C) team in Hyderabad. We uphold quality, excellence, and genuine care in everything we do — and we're looking for someone who takes that standard personally — someone who is passionate about building a great place to work.
 



  





 As a People \+ Culture Coordinator \- Trainee, you will take real ownership across employee experience, company events, facilities coordination, and workplace management for our India offices. This is a hands\-on role and you will be central to helping cultivate the dynamic, people\-first culture we are proud of at PureSpectrum. The Coordinator will report to the Director, People \+ Culture and collaborate with global teams in a fast\-paced, high\-growth organization.
 



  





**This is a 3\-month, full\-time internship based out of our Hyderabad office at Hitec City, Madhapur (5 days a week, in\-office). Outstanding performance during the internship will lead to a full\-time offer to People \+ Culture Coordinator position at the end of 3 months internship program.** 
*Please note: This is a full\-time on\-the\-job training opportunity and not a short\-term academic project internship (typically completed during the course of education).* 




  





**Role Responsibilities:** 




 As part of your day\-to\-day responsibilities, you will support a diverse range of functions that contribute to employee experience and smooth office operations.
 



  





**People \+ Culture Administration** 



* Facilitate a smooth onboarding experience, including welcome kits, desk setup, ID cards, IT coordination, and access provisioning.
* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, holiday celebrations, wellness activities, employee gifts and surveys.
* Schedule and coordinate orientation sessions, team meetings, interviews and company\-wide employee events.
* Planning and supporting DIEB (Diversity, Inclusion, Equity \& Belonging) initiatives.

**Facilities \& Office Management** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for the India offices at Hyderabad and Jaipur. Be the go\-to on\-ground point of contact for all matters related to the workplace.
* Liaise effectively with facility managers and service providers for timely issue resolution.
* Own office inventory \- track, manage, replenish and oversee related logistics.
* Supervise vendors, ensuring service\-level agreements are upheld.
* Coordinate logistics for leadership visits, guests or teams and internal events.



  





**You Must Have:** 




 Master's degree in Human Resources or MBA in HR from a reputed University.
 


* 1\-2 years of experience in HR coordination/ HR administration is preferred. Freshers with strong internship or campus activity are welcome to apply.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, employee engagement and workplace management.
* Sound knowledge of labor laws, statutory compliance for the workplace.
* Excellent organizational skills, multitasking abilities, and strong time management. Ability to focus and get things done; able to deal with conflicting priorities and ambiguity.
* Clear, warm and professional communication.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, Google Workspace, calendar tools, Canva, and collaboration tools such as Slack.
* Experience with Excel functions such as VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and other commonly used formulas.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience in coordinating with third\-party vendors and service providers.
* High level of discretion when handling sensitive information and the ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Proactive ownership mindset and follow through. Ability to work independently, anticipate challenges and provide effective solutions in a fast\-paced evolving environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster positive relationships across teams.



  




* This role operates primarily on the EMEA shift (1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST). The person in this role must also be open to working night shifts and flexible across other global time zones (US, APAC) based on business requirements. Job Summary

The Tech Support Executive will be responsible for providing technical support in electrical auditing, testing, commissioning, and engineering services. The role involves site execution, electrical testing, data collection, technical report preparation, estimation support, and coordination with clients and internal teams to ensure timely and quality project delivery.

* HT/LT Switchgear
* Protection Relays

* Quantity Take\-Offs (QTO)
* Equipment Lists
* Scope of Work
* Assist in preparing quotations and cost estimates.
* Identify project execution requirements and site constraints.

5\. Documentation \& Technical Coordination

* Maintain project documentation, test reports, calibration certificates, and client records.
* Coordinate with field engineers and project teams for timely report completion.
* Ensure proper document control and record management.

6\. Client Coordination

* Interact professionally with clients during site visits and project execution.
* Respond to technical queries related to testing activities and reports.
* Participate in technical discussions, project meetings, and presentations.

7\. MIS \& Administrative Support

* Prepare weekly and monthly project progress reports.
* Track project status, pending activities, and report submissions.
* Support management by maintaining technical and operational MIS reports.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering.

Experience

* 0–3 years of experience in:
* Electrical Testing
* Electrical Safety Audits
* Commissioning
* Technical Support
* Electrical Maintenance
* Freshers with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of electrical systems, testing methods, and safety practices.
* Ability to read electrical drawings and Single Line Diagrams (SLDs).
* Good technical report writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively for site assignments across India.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Technical Knowledge

Candidates having knowledge or exposure to the following areas will be preferred:

* Electrical Safety Audits
* Energy Audits \& Energy Efficiency Studies
* Power Quality Analysis
* Thermography
* Transformer Testing
* Earthing System Testing
* Relay Testing
* HT/LT Switchgear Testing
* Electrical Commissioning Activities
* Electrical Installation Testing

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of assigned site activities.
* Accuracy and quality of testing data and technical reports.
* Proper maintenance of project documentation.
* Effective coordination with clients and internal teams.
* Compliance with safety standards and company procedures.
* Contribution towards successful project execution and business targets.

Why Join Elecserve Tech Solutions?

* Opportunity to work on diverse industrial and commercial projects across India.
* Hands\-on exposure to advanced electrical testing and diagnostic technologies.
* Continuous learning and professional development.
* Career growth in Electrical Auditing, Testing, Commissioning, and Power Quality Engineering.
* Collaborative and technology\-driven work environment.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

 We are looking for a highly motivated
 **Data Engineer**

You will be responsible for developing scalable ETL workflows, transforming raw data into analytics\-ready datasets, and ensuring high data quality and reliability.

title: Associate AI Engineer
description:
**Associate AI Engineer** 




**Levent Analytics \| Raipur, India \| Office, full time** 




  





 Most enterprise AI stops at the pilot. Levent Analytics is a boutique AI services firm built to take agentic and predictive AI into production: in the client's data, on their platforms, accountable to their outcomes. We are hiring an Associate AI Engineer in Raipur to build that production work for clients across the GCC and beyond.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Ship your first production contribution inside 90 days: a working piece of a client agent or RAG pipeline, with senior review.
* Build and test LLM integrations: prompts, retrieval, tool calling, and the evaluation harnesses that prove they work.
* Contribute to our internal delivery accelerators, designed to compress month\-long consulting delivery into sprints.
* Write the tests, logging, and documentation that make AI systems operable, not just demoable.
* Shadow client sessions from early on; by the one\-year mark you own tasks across an accelerator or client component and ship with lighter review.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* You write clean Python and are comfortable with Git and code review.
* You can explain how embeddings, retrieval, and LLM APIs fit together, at working depth.
* You have built something real with an LLM (project, internship, or open source) and can walk us through your decisions.
* Solid fundamentals: data structures, debugging, reading unfamiliar code.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with an interest in applying AI to business and operational challenges.
* Clear written and spoken communication; we serve international clients.



  





 Nice to have: exposure to Dataiku, Databricks, or any major cloud. Agent and RAG frameworks vary by engagement; you will pick up whatever the client runs.
 



  





 If you hit most of the must\-haves, apply. We would rather talk to ten near\-misses than miss one great fit.
 



  





**How we work** 




 You work directly with the senior engineers who own the client relationship, with no layers of management in between. Everything you ship gets structured senior review, with a defined capability path to the next level.
 



  





 The honest part: we are a small firm with thin process and real client deadlines. Everyone ships production work, not decks. If you want high ownership and direct access to senior people, that is the offer; if you want big\-company structure, this role will frustrate you.
 



  





 Our team has shipped production AI for airlines, energy, retail, and utilities over 15\+ years.
 



  





**Package** 



* Health insurance (self coverage)
* 15 days annual leave minimum, increasing with level
* Company laptop
* Assistance finding accommodation if you relocate to Raipur
* International travel when client work requires it



  





**Process** 



1. Screening call: background and fit.
2. Live coding session: Python and problem solving.
3. Case study round: how you approach a client\-style AI problem.



  





 The full process typically completes within two weeks.
 



  





 Levent Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

description:

 We are looking for a highly experienced Edge Network Engineer to lead complex edge, network, and cloud platform deployments. This role will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert during onboarding, migrations, and new platform integrations. Success in this role requires exceptional technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead both technical workstreams and customer expectations.
   

  

 The Edge Network Engineer position provides customer facing network design, implementation, configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocols, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, this role also serves as a Tier 4 escalation point from the global support organization.
   

  

**Experience with SD\-WAN—especially Versa Networks—is a major asset and will elevate your candidacy.**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD\-WAN platforms.
* Act as the technical point of contact for end\-to\-end implementation activities, including architecture planning, configuration, testing, and go\-live support.

* Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks.

* Document procedures, configurations, and lessons learned; contribute to internal knowledge bases.
* Mentor junior engineers and participate in internal enablement and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Participate in periodic customer workshops to review implementation design as needed to support large\-scale or complex rollouts.


**Qualifications:**
* Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies; experience with lightweight Kubernetes distributions (e.g., K3s) preferred.
* Strong understanding of networking principles including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, NAT, Routing protocols and proxies.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual.
* Prior experience with SD\-WAN deployment and management; Versa SD\-WAN experience is a strong plus.
* Proficiency in using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables, netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities.
* Experience with cloud service providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration, and SSO setup.
* Comfortable working with REST APIs and using tools like Postman, Swagger, curl, and Python scripts for automation and testing.
* Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption, and measured boot is a plus (can be trained internally).
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bash scripting.
* Experience with tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM platforms for Project/Change/Incident management.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate across teams.


**Preferred Background:**
* 5\+ years in edge infrastructure deployment, implementation engineering, or similar technical field.

**Job Title:** 
 Business Analyst
   

  

**Department** 
 : ITG FRS
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Under BNP Paribas IT Group, ITTF FRS is the IT framework encompassing Projects \& Systems of Finance and RISK functions, with a strong focus on efficiency, proximity, agility and time\-to\-market.
   

  

 FRS is a worldwide organizational model that will contribute to tackle major challenges of the Group’s transformation of today and tomorrow, building the best offering to the Finance and Risk Community through a progressive rotation to new technologies and best practices. The FRS organization is the outcome of several convergences: between the Project \& Systems teams of Group Finance, CIB Finance and RISK and their related IT teams.
   

  

 FRS is part of the IT Group organization (ITG in Europe and ITO overseas) with a threefold sponsorship by ITG, Finance and RISK (CIB\-ITO; RISK Solutions and ITG\-FIT).
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 Shared Data Ecosystem (SDE) is an ITG\-FRS department hosting various applications relating to the “filière unique program” in charge of collecting Accounting and Risk data from local entities in an unique stream.
   

  

 ITTF is responsible for aligning IT programs with the strategy and objectives of our business partners in the Finance and Risk functions. Within ITTF you will join the Capital Reporting Systems branch, more specifically the ARC team "All Capital Reportings".
   

  

 ARC is an application that enables the consolidation of data for Solvency calculation and the production of regulatory and analytical reporting. The clients and users of application are the reporting teams of Finance Group and business lines (PF, BGL, BNL, Fortis, etc)
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

 As a Business Analyst, you will participate in all the processes within the team:
   

  

* Project: Collection / Analysis of needs, proposal of solutions, business requirements, developers support, developments tests, Change management / Training and support for users
* Production: Application configuration, participation in production tasks, analysis of anomalies reported by users, support on production incidents. On\-call duty during non\-working hours/days according to the Production closing calendar is to be expected
* Behavioral competencies: You’re rigorous, you know how to adapt. You can take initiatives and work as a team and collaborate across the board.


 You are capable of analysis as well as synthesis and are organized. You have the ability to produce high quality deliverables.
   

  

 The position requires a taste for analysis and human contacts, this dynamic work is conducted with many international stakeholders. All of this in an ever\-evolving environment that responds to both external constraints from regulators (new CCR3 regulations) and increasingly rich and demanding internal management needs of the bank. You will be joining a very friendly team that is committed to client satisfaction and knowledge sharing.
   

  

 Working knowledge in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and SharePoint.
   

  

**Good To Have Skills**
* SQL


 Experience in Finance/ Accounting domain as a Business Analyst
   

  

 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

 Contribute to overall FRS as directed by Team and Department Management.
   

  

**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Ability to collaborate / teamwork
* Ability to synthesize / simplify
* Ability to communicate \- orally and in writing
* Ability to analyse
* Ability to develop and adapt a process
* Ability to anticipate business / strategic changes
* Ability to understand, explain and lead change
* Ability to develop others and their skills
* Strong interpersonal communication (spoken and written) and Customer/Users orientation skills
* Ability to simplify complex information in a clearly organized and visually interesting manner
* Pro\-active behavior regarding the ability to work in a fast changing and demanding environment
* At ease with multi\-tasking
* Strong analytical mind and problem\-solving skills
* Have the ability to produce high quality deliverables.
* Be aligned with the BNP Values: Agility, Compliance Culture, Openness, Client Satisfaction.


 Other competencies
   

  

* Computer knowledge
* IT / Business relations
* Steering of production operations
* IT Tests
* Financial/fiscal knowledge
* Knowledge of risks and awareness of risks.

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. description:
***hackajob** 
 is collaborating with
 **Barclays** 
 to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.*
 Join us as Software Engineer at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Software Engineer, you should have experience with:
   

  

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximize the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerization etc.
* Strong proficiency in Java 11\+/17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Microservices architecture.
* Experience in designing and developing event\-driven systems.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defense in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardized solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity, and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the bank’s governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Consult on complex issues, providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organization sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practices (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Software Engineer
description:
You will be a member of a software engineering team that develops tools and integrations for a portfolio of cloud infrastructure services supporting Cisco’s critical business operations.
   

  

 As a Software (AI / Private Cloud / Virtualization) Engineer with extensive experience in enterprise\-level private cloud and AI\-driven automation setups, you will join a dynamic and agile team of engineers focused on developing platform automation, operational tooling, and intelligent systems for large\-scale infrastructure environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Software Engineer with the Cloud Infrastructure Platform Team, you will:
   

  

* Participate in architect and design scalable solutions supporting Infrastructure and AI Platform Services for enterprise private cloud environments.
* Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for managing large\-scale OpenStack\-based private cloud infrastructure.
* Develop and deliver software/tools required for building and improving the functionality, reliability, availability, and manageability of applications/services and cloud platforms using a DevOps model.
* Ensure the quality, performance, robustness, and scalability of the services you implement.
* Drive AIOps initiatives across infrastructure platforms by collaborating with multi\-functional teams including SRE and Software Engineers to operationalize and optimize AI/LLM\-based automation solutions.
* Develop infrastructure automation tools and frameworks using Python along with automation tools such as Ansible and CI/CD pipelines.
* Build AI\-powered assistants, RAG\-based systems, or agentic automation solutions to help automate operational workflows across the private cloud platform.
* Collaborate with platform and SRE teams to identify automation opportunities and develop plug\-and\-play AI solutions for platform operations.
* Assist in implementing AIOps practices such as intelligent monitoring, log analysis, alert correlation, and automated remediation workflows.
* Automate the development, testing, and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines using Git, GitHub Actions,CI, Jenkins, Helm, or similar tools.
* Develop microservices and REST APIs supporting infrastructure automation and operational tooling.
* Work with containerized environments and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability, and performance through strong engineering practices, observability, and automation.
* Conduct code reviews, establish engineering best practices, and mentor junior engineers.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies in AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, and automation to influence platform enhancements.
* Apply global knowledge of IT infrastructure to develop standard solutions that can be leveraged across multiple areas.
* Evaluate new and emerging technologies and determine their applicability to the platform engineering group.
* Generate ideas and technical strategies and present them to peers and stakeholders for feedback.


**Minimum Qualifications / Requirement**
* Experience: 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including exposure to AI/ML or AI\-driven automation initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience operating or automating OpenStack\-based private cloud environments.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Experience with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible or puppet.
* Experience working with Kubernetes for cluster management, container orchestration, and platform services.
* Experience with Docker containerization and microservices\-based architectures.
* Experience developing AI or LLM\-powered operational assistants, chatbots, or internal developer tools.
* Experience implementing RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines to query operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure data.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure or platform services using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability platforms used in large\-scale distributed systems.
* Experience working with databases such as MySQL, MongoDB, or similar systems.
* Experience working with messaging systems such as Kafka or similar event\-streaming platforms.
* Interest in applying AI and machine learning techniques to platform operations, automation, and AIOps initiatives.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills in complex distributed systems.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to architectural or technical decision\-making.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Entry Software Engineer is responsible for assisting in the design and development of processes for manufacturing chemicals and related products. This role involves working under the guidance of experienced engineers, conducting research, analyzing data, and contributing to the optimization of production processes.
   

  

**List the essential functions and major activities in order of their importance.**
* Design and architect components
* 3 years minimum of Windows application development (C\#/.net) in a team environment
* Proven ability to develop applications in a large\-scale, high\-performance environment
* Experience developing desktop applications using UWP, WPF
* Experience using Entity Framework, or similar object relational mapping tools.
* Experience using SQL Server, or similar relational database management systems.
* Experience and understanding of design patterns and dependency injection.
* Experience and understanding of unit testing.
* Understanding of SOLID principals.
* Detail\-oriented and organized.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ensure the quality of releases, including participating in peer code reviews.
* Integrate internal software with third\-party applications.
* Support existing software in the organization.


**Minimum professional and educational background desired (include years of experience)**
* BS in Computer Science or BE/B.Tech in Computer Science/Electronics \& Communication or related fields or Master in Science in Software or MCA
* 3\+ years of experience in C\# application development (WPF/UWP) and User Interface creation(HTML/CSS/JS/MS Blazor)
* CI/CD (GIT/ Jira/ Bitbucket/ Jenkins)
* C\# application development
* Good to have MAUI
* Good to have ASP.NET MVC/Web API knowledge


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.**
**Software Engineer**
 Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning, and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast\-paced,
   

  

 ideas\-led environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 As a Software Engineer in the Product Operating Model (POM), your focus is on building high\-quality, reliable, and scalable software that delivers business value. You are accountable for owning development, optimization, and automation activities; writing clean and maintainable code; practicing test\-driven development; and collaborating closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and fellow Developers. You contribute to solution design, ensure adherence to engineering best practices, and take ownership of features from development through testing and delivery.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Get To**
* Participate in mission\-critical projects with direct impact on the evolution of Priceline's business.
* Be part of a cross\-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates, and delivers on new product objectives.
* Showcase your development skills in Core Java or similar programming languages.
* Apply your programming skills towards building low\-latency and high\-throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing.
* Implement SQL composition skills that collect and query data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications.
* Utilize your knowledge to understand our codebase, systems, and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications.
* Effectively collaborate and engage in team efforts, speak up for what you think are the best solutions, and be able to converse respectfully and compromise when necessary.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in software engineering and development.
* Strong coding experience with Core Java.
* Thorough SQL composition skills for querying and data analysis.
* Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot and building RESTful APIs, as well as familiarity with gRPC\-based services.
* Experience in Microservices architecture is a MUST, including inter\-service communication using REST and/or gRPC.
* Experience with cloud platforms, especially GCP or AWS/Azure.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability, and Trust. "The Right Results, the Right Way" is not just a motto at Priceline; it's a way of working.


**Who We Are**
 WE ARE PRICELINE.
   

  

 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
   

  

**Flexible work at Priceline**
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
   

  

**Inclusion is a Big Deal !**
 To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
   

  

 Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
   

  

**Applying for this position**
 We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
 **current employees** 
 , please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
   

  

 External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

description:
***hackajob**

 **Barclays** 
 to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.*
 Join us as a Software Engineer at Barclays, where you will enable high\-performing Agile teams across the BFA Channels landscape. You will drive delivery excellence, foster continuous improvement, and leverage AI\-powered insights to enhance team productivity, predictability, and decision\-making. You will act as a servant leader, working closely with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders to remove impediments, manage dependencies, and ensure delivery outcomes align with business objectives.
   

  

 To be successful as an Engineer; you should have experience with:
   

  

* Java (JDK 21\), Rest API, AI literacy.
* Spring Boot.
* Microservices architecture.
* Jenkins CICD.
* GitLab.
* Design patterns \& clean coding practices.
* Kubernetes, Openshift
* Experience in SQL.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* API gateway patterns
* Observability (ELK/Splunk/AppDynamics)
* Automated tests.
* CI/CD (GitLab).
* Observability (ELK/Splunk/AppDynamics)
* Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes.
* Exposure to performance tuning and distributed systems.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum environment.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, including Agile Delivery, AI \& Digital Fluency, Risk \& Controls, Change \& Transformation, Strategic Thinking, and Technology Leadership.
   

  

 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Fullstack Java With React-Software Engineer III
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Artificial Intelligence \& Engineering
   

  

 AI \& Engineering leverages  cutting\-edge  engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and  operate  integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission\-critical operations.
   

  

 Join our AI \& Engineering team to help transform technology platforms,  driving  innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements.  You’ll  work alongside talented  professionals  reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 Level: Software Engineer III
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high\-quality engineering solutions that support enterprise applications and client transformation initiatives. In this role, you will contribute across backend and front\-end development, apply modern engineering practices, and help deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. You will also support continuous improvement through automation, innovation, and strong execution within project timelines.
   

  

 Work you'll do
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …
   

  

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing React applications using TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and integration with RESTful or GraphQL services
* Evaluating solution options, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, scalable, and maintainable design decisions
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
* Supporting process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes.


 The T eam
   

  

 Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering\-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
   

  

 Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* Core JAVA \& Backend engineering :
* 6\-10 years of strong hands\-on experience in JAVA( 8 \+) with solid grounding in Object\-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
* Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade\-offs
* Spring \& Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high\-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter\-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
* Experience implementing security and cloud\-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
* Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS \& SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* React
* 4 \- 7 years of hands\-on experience in React :
* Strong hands\-on experience building scalable and production\-grade React applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Strong understanding of React fundamentals, including JSX, component lifecycle, hooks, rendering behaviour , and component composition
* Experience implementing state management and data\-fetching patterns, using Context API and modern state libraries ( e.g. , Redux Toolkit/ Zustand / Recoil ) based on application complexity.
* Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross\-browser compatibility
* Hands\-on experience integrating React applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract\-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including route protection, secure token handling , and role\-based UI behavior.
* Strong testing and debugging skills with unit/component testing (Jest, React Testing Library) and end\-to\-end testing (Cypress/Playwright), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with React performance optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, memoization strategies, and efficient rendering of large data sets
* Familiarity with React build tooling, including modern bundlers (Webpack/Vite), environment configuration, and deployment optimization.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership\-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding.


 Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high\-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery\-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains

title: Part Time HR Consultant
description:
About Zerobeli

Zerobeli is a fast\-growing healthy food manufacturing company specializing in wholegrain, millet\-based and clean\-label bakery products. We are looking for an experienced HR professional to help build structured HR systems as we scale.

Role

We are looking for a practical HR Consultant who can help us establish strong HR processes, policies and systems suitable for a growing manufacturing company.

This is not a routine recruitment role.

We are looking for someone who can build long\-term HR foundations.

Key ResponsibilitiesHR Policies

* Develop Employee Handbook
* Attendance Policy
* Leave Policy
* Probation \& Confirmation Policy
* Performance Review Process
* Increment \& Promotion Guidelines
* Code of Conduct
* Disciplinary Process
* Exit Process

Recruitment System

* Create structured hiring process
* Prepare Job Descriptions
* Develop interview scorecards
* Build candidate database
* Improve hiring process
* Suggest recruitment channels
* Help identify good candidates when required

Employee Systems

* Design onboarding process
* Employee documentation
* Offer letters
* Appointment letters
* Confirmation letters
* Exit documentation

Performance Management

* Develop KPIs for various departments
* Suggest appraisal framework
* Improve accountability
* Help managers implement systems

HR Compliance

* Advise on HR best practices
* Ensure HR documentation is organized
* Recommend improvements where required

Preferred Experience

* 8\+ years HR experience
* Experience with manufacturing/FMCG companies
* Experience creating HR systems from scratch
* Practical approach
* Comfortable working with founders

We are looking for someone who can

✅ Build practical HR systems

✅ Improve organization structure

✅ Help create scalable processes

✅ Guide management on HR best practices

✅ Support recruitment strategy

Engagement

* Part\-time / Consultant
* Flexible working model
* Periodic factory visits required
* Available for guidance as needed

Application Question(s):

* Tell about one company where you built HR systems from scratch. What exactly did you create, and what changed after your work?

Experience:

* HR: 6 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Placement Coordinator – IT Training Institute
description:
RLT Edzaro is a leading IT Training Institute focused on delivering industry\-oriented programs in AI, Cloud Computing, Full Stack Development, Cybersecurity, Data Science, DevOps, and other emerging technologies. We are looking for an experienced Placement Coordinator to strengthen our corporate network and ensure successful student placements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with IT companies, startups, and recruitment partners.
* Develop new corporate tie\-ups for internships and placement opportunities.
* Coordinate placement drives, walk\-ins, virtual interviews, and campus recruitment activities.
* Connect with HRs, Talent Acquisition teams, and hiring managers to identify hiring requirements.
* Match eligible students with suitable job openings based on their skills and career goals.
* Organize mock interviews, resume\-building sessions, and placement readiness programs.
* Track student placement status and maintain accurate placement records and reports.
* Follow up with recruiters regarding interview feedback and hiring updates.
* Collaborate with trainers and the student counselling team to improve placement outcomes.
* Meet monthly placement targets and continuously expand the recruiter network.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience as a Placement Coordinator in an IT Training Institute.
* Existing network and strong contacts with multiple IT companies, HR professionals, and recruitment agencies.
* Proven experience in corporate tie\-ups and placement coordination.
* Good understanding of IT job roles including AI, Cloud, Full Stack, DevOps, Data Science, Testing, Cybersecurity, and Software Development.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to organize placement events and manage multiple recruitment activities simultaneously.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and MS Office skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with EdTech or IT training organizations.
* Knowledge of current IT hiring trends and recruitment processes.
* Experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.
* Strong networking and corporate relationship\-building abilities.

title: Branch Manager - Gold Loan - Guwahati Fancy Bazar
description:
Designation: Branch Manager


Location: India Tamil Nadu Orion Place, Guwahati


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

###### 

**Basic Details:** *Fill the required information about business, unit, location, position, reports to position and date of updation of JD*
===========================================================================================================================================

 **Business**  

Financial Services **Unit**  

Aditya Birla Capital Limited **Location**  

Across branches in India  

  

**1\) Job Purpose:** *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* **(****Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition. **Managing Existing Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management **Structuring new Transactions**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives
=========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Relationship Type (Max 80 Characters)**
=========================================

**Frequency**
=============

**Nature (Max 1325 Characters)**
================================

 **Internal**  

Regional / Cluster Heads  

Daily  

Business planning, target reviews, risk, productivity, and governance discussions.  

IT Team  

Weekly / Need\-based  

System issues, process enhancements, user support.  

Marketing Team  

Weekly / Fortnightly  

Local campaigns, lead generation, customer engagement programs.  

Risk, Policy, Audit, Compliance, HR  

Weekly / Need\-based  

Escalations, deviations, training needs, audit observations, hiring support. **External**  

Customers  

Need\-based  

Product queries, service support, relationship building, grievance resolution.  

Vendors / Security Partners  

Need\-based  

Vault security, system maintenance, operational support.  

Local Influencers / Community Stakeholders  

Need\-based  

Acquisitions, outreach, local awareness building.

About Us
  
  

Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.
  
  

From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity\-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.
  
  

Grow a Career. Build a Future!
  
  

Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.
  
  

Job Purpose
  
  

The HR Operations Support Specialist is responsible for delivering efficient HR Shared Services support across the employee lifecycle, HR systems administration, employee benefits administration, data management, compliance support, and employee engagement programs. The role acts as a key point of contact for employees, managers, and HR stakeholders, ensuring accurate and timely HR service delivery while maintaining data integrity and compliance with company policies and procedures.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as the HR Shared Services (HRSS) SPOC for designated business units and provide end\-to\-end HR operational support.
* Manage employee lifecycle transactions, including onboarding, employee movements, organizational changes, and separation processes.
* Administer and maintain employee records and HR systems, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
* Provide employee and manager support through HR helpdesk services and resolve queries within defined service levels.
* Coordinate and administer employee benefits, wellness programs, recognition initiatives, and other HR programs as applicable.
* Support HR compliance activities, including documentation, background verification, data privacy, audits, and statutory requirements.
* Generate, validate, and maintain HR reports, dashboards, metrics, and management information systems (MIS).
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure smooth delivery of HR services and programs.
* Support HR projects, process improvement initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous improvement activities.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, processes, and service delivery standards.
* Smoothly manage the all related audits and vendor performance, escalation Etc.,


Experience Required
  
  

Overall 5\+ years experience in HR and At least 3\+ Years in HR Operations
  
  

**Skills Required:**  

1\. Good communication skill and stakeholder management abilities.
  
2\. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Office 365 applications.
  
3\. Experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, or Employee Lifecycle Management.
  
4\. Good in multitasking
  
5\. Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes.
  
6\. Strong analytical, reporting \& Vendor Manangement skills.
  
7\. People Oriented and approachable
  
8\. Confident
  
9\. Working in HRMS tools like SAP \& SF experience will be a plus
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Graduation \- BBA/ Bcom / BSc
  
MBA\-HR ( will be added Advantage)

We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.
  
  

At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:
  
  

Flexible work arrangements
  
Savings \& Retirement benefits
