title: Apprentice- Product Management
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-potential
 **Product Manager Apprentice** 
 to join our Product Management team working on next\-generation
 **Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS)** 
 platforms. This role is designed for early\-career professionals who are passionate about building enterprise SaaS products and want hands\-on exposure to
 **AI\-driven customer experience technologies and modern cloud\-native architectures** 
 .
   

  

 As a Product Manager Apprentice, you will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, Data Science, and GTM teams to define, build, and scale features across our CCaaS product lines — including
 **AI\-powered voice, digital, analytics, automation, workforce management and integrations platforms** 
 .
   

  

 This is a learning\-intensive role that provides real ownership, structured mentorship, and exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-growing SaaS environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Discovery \& Strategy Support**
* Assist in researching customer problems across contact center domains such as Inbound, outbound campaigns, agent experience, AI automation, analytics, Quality Management, Workforce Management, and integrations
* Analyze market trends in CCaaS, AI in CX, cloud communications, and SaaS platforms
* Support product managers in defining product vision, value propositions, and roadmap priorities


**AI \& Data\-Driven Product Development**
* Work with AI/ML teams on features involving speech\-to\-text, NLP, LLMs, conversation intelligence, automation, and predictive analytics
* Help translate AI capabilities into real\-world customer use cases and measurable business outcomes
* Contribute to defining product requirements for AI\-enabled workflows and decisioning systems


**Requirements \& Delivery Execution**
* Assist in creating Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Work closely with engineering teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies to support sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release execution
* Participate in feature demos, UAT coordination, and release readiness activities


**Modern SaaS Platform Exposure**
* Gain hands\-on experience with cloud\-native, multi\-tenant SaaS architectures, APIs, microservices, security, and scalability concepts
* Support integration initiatives across CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), CPaaS providers, and enterprise ecosystems


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Join customer calls, usability sessions, and beta programs to capture feedback and validate product direction
* Support preparation of product documentation, internal enablement, and launch materials


**What You Will Learn**
* How enterprise CCaaS platforms are built and scaled
* How AI is productized — from model capability to customer value
* How to balance customer needs, technology constraints, and business strategy
* How modern SaaS companies execute product management at scale


**Eligibility \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science (or related technical discipline)
* Strong interest in Product Management, SaaS platforms, AI technologies, and cloud computing
* Basic understanding of software development concepts, APIs, and web technologies
* Familiarity with Agile development practices is a plus


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Excellent communication and structured thinking skills
* Curiosity about AI, data platforms, and digital customer experience technologies
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, design, and business teams
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and learning


**Career Path**
 This apprenticeship is designed to develop future
 **Associate Product Owners , Associate Product Managers and Product Managers** 
 . High performers will have the opportunity to transition into a full\-time product management role with increased ownership of product areas.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
* Work on a market\-leading CCaaS platform from Five9 shaping the future of customer experience
* Get early exposure to AI\-first product development in a real enterprise environment
* Structured mentorship from experienced product leaders
* Opportunity to grow rapidly in one of the fastest\-growing technology domains


 Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.
   

  

 Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Location \- Ahmedabad On Site** 




**Max CTC Offered \- 7\-8 LPA** 




  





 We’re building our
 **core product team** 
 at
 **Shipmnts** 
 , and this is your chance to join at the ground level. It’s a high\-ownership, high\-impact role where you’ll grow exponentially as a product leader. If you’re passionate about solving real\-world problems, simplifying complexity, and building a category\-defining business, we might be the perfect place for you to do the best work of your life.
 



  





 🌱 Our Product Culture
 



 At Shipmnts, we believe in
 **deep user empathy** 
 ,
 **first\-principles thinking** 
 , and
 **tight cross\-functional collaboration** 
 . Our product development rhythm is built on a practical loop of:
 **Ground Research → ShapeUp → Feedback → Design → Deploy → Iterate.** 




 We take inspiration from
 **Jobs To Be Done** 
 and
 **Deconstructing Work Elements** 
 to understand the real value users seek—and we embed ourselves in their daily operations to truly understand their world. We believe product thinking isn’t just about building—it’s about deeply
 **understanding** 
 ,
 **prioritizing** 
 , and
 **simplifying** 
 .
 



  





 🧭
 **What You'll Own** 




 A product cloud — end to end. From the earliest discovery signal to post\-launch iteration, you are the single accountable person for your product area's direction and outcomes.
 



 🔍
 **Discovery \& Domain Depth** 



* Develop genuine operational expertise — not just user interviews, but workflow shadowing, support mining, and cohort\-level behavioral analysis
* Synthesize findings into sharp problem frames: the underlying job to be done and the exact friction blocking it
* Maintain a live insight repository that feeds roadmap decisions continuously



 🗺️
 **Roadmapping \& Prioritization** 



* Own the multi\-quarter roadmap — balancing near\-term delivery, mid\-term bets, and platform investments
* Prioritize using RICE, opportunity sizing, and sharp judgment — defend your calls to leadership with clarity
* Document deprioritization explicitly; the roadmap is only credible when stakeholders understand what's not on it and why



 🤖
 **AI Prototyping** 



* Rapidly prototype multiple solution directions using AI\-assisted tools before committing engineering capacity
* Run timebox prototype sprints, surface trade\-offs across competing approaches, and treat every prototype as a learning instrument — not a deliverable



 🔪
 **Deciding What to Build and What to Kill** 



* Design eval frameworks across user comprehension, task completion, and business value
* Score prototypes on a clear rubric, run usability sessions, and make the call — with explicit rationale and conviction



 ⚙️
 **Shaping, Speccing \& Building** 



* Translate winning prototypes into unambiguous, engineer\-ready specs: flows, edge cases, state definitions, data contracts, and acceptance criteria
* Act as the connective tissue between design and engineering — unblocking in real time, not in the next sprint
* Own sprint planning, scope decisions, and delivery accountability; know when cutting scope cuts value



 📈
 **Growth Experiments \& Metrics** 



* Define the north star and health metrics for your product cloud — and own activation, adoption, and retention outcomes
* Design structured experiments with clear hypotheses, ship features instrumented from day one, and build a compounding library of learnings



 💰
 **Pricing, Packaging \& GTM** 



* Think through pricing implications for every major feature — base plan, tier uplift, or usage\-based
* Write launch briefs that arm Sales and CS with positioning, FAQs, and objection handling before go\-live
* Define launch success criteria upfront: adoption curve, revenue contribution, support deflection, NPS signal



 🚀
 **Launching \& Iteration** 



* Coordinate cross\-functional launches and track adoption cohorts week\-over\-week post\-release
* Run structured retrospectives after every major launch — not for compliance, but to get sharper



  





 ✅
 **What You'll Bring** 



* 2–3 years of Total Work Experience
* 2\-3 years of Experience as a Business Analyst / Product Owner or
* 1 year of Experience in Product Management with a track record of end\-to\-end ownership and measurable outcomes
* Strong command of discovery, prioritisation, and execution — the muscle, not just the framework
* Clear, structured writing — your docs make decisions easier, not harder
* Comfortable with data: basic SQL, dashboard interpretation, and experiment design without needing an analyst
* Experience with AI tools in your workflow — prototyping, spec writing, or research acceleration
* Experience with Design Tools



 🎁
 **What You'll Get** 



* Full ownership of a product cloud with real enterprise customers and real complexity
* A direct seat at the strategic table with leadership
* A team that values craft and depth over velocity theater
* Competitive comp with meaningful upside as Shipmnts scales



 🧠
 **Who You Are** 




 You think in systems but execute in specifics. You hold strong opinions and update them when evidence shifts. You're a strong writer, a sharp decision\-maker, and you want ownership — not just responsibility. You know the difference.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market\-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high\-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS\-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost\-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading\-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all\-wafer\-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS\-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 Essential Skills:
   

  

* Hands on academic/industrial experience with programing in Java or C\+\+
* Good understanding of Object Oriented Design, Data Structures and Algorithms
* Good problem solving and communication skills
* Ability and interest in learning new skills on the job
* Comfortable leveraging AI‑based tools to enhance software development and engineering productivity.


 Preferred skills:
   

  

* Scripting languages like Python
* Domain knowledge in one of the following areas; electronic design automation (EDA), Image Processing, Image Computing, Machine Control.


 Travel:
   

  

* This position requires 10\-15% travel to customer site(s) worldwide.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign is looking for a software engineer to join our cloud engineering team, focused on building highly scalable, available, and reliable distributed systems. You will be responsible for designing high\-performance, resilient architectures, developing microservices frameworks, and implementing cloud\-based data platform systems to support global\-scale business needs. You will also work on infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Terraform\-based deployments.
   

  

 This position is n individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Develop testable, high\-quality, and ship\-ready code with ample test coverage
* Work as part of a cross\-site development team to drive design, implementation, testing, and release of microservices platforms
* Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform to deploy and maintain cloud environments
* Participate in on\-call rotations and contribute to improving system reliability and incident response
* Designing, building, and maintaining robust data platform solutions leveraging modern tools


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on software development experience in an object\-oriented programming language such as C\#, C\+\+, or Java
* 2\+ years of working with cloud deployment and configuration tools using scripting and configuration platforms
* Hands\-on experience with cloud object storage (e.g., Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage) and/or eventing/messaging platforms (e.g., Azure Event Hub, GCP Pub/Sub), including security hardening, lifecycle management, and cross\-cloud abstraction patterns
* Proficiency in managing data platform infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform
* Experience with being part of an on\-call rotation


**Preferred**
* Experience in a SaaS environment and practical knowledge of cloud technologies for Distributed systems
* Passion for exploring new technologies and a proven track record as a self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
   

  

 If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
**Why We Exist** 


 Mental health is an epidemic that’s getting worse day by day. Depression, anxiety, ADHD, suicide, and PTSD are at an all\-time high. This needs to change. We humans were not made for this sort of life. We were never designed for the sedentary, indoor, socially isolated, fast\-food\-laden, sleep\-deprived, frenzied pace of modern life. We are being robbed by the same tech that was meant to add value to our lives. It’s time for a change.
 





 Our team at Mellow Labs is building the future of mental health by bridging the gaps between science and mental health. Our aim as an organization is to create systemic impact, especially in underrepresented populations. We are currently building for women’s brain health, as it’s an area with poor clinical and scientific validation.
 




**1993 — the first\-ever clinical trials were conducted on women.** 




**1996 — the first\-ever brain scans on women.** 





 Only 1% of all brain scans represent a woman’s brain, and our team wants to change that by bringing neurotechnology to women to improve their mental health.
 



**The Impact You’ll Have** 


 This isn’t an app that helps people order food faster. The product you build will sit at the intersection of neuroscience and daily life — helping women understand and improve their brain health in a field where they’ve been overlooked for decades. Every screen you ship, every hardware integration you get right, directly shapes whether someone gets insight into their own mind that medicine has never offered them before.
 





 You’ll be one of the first engineers on a product with the potential to close a decades\-old gap in brain science. The data flowing through your code could contribute to the largest effort yet to represent women’s brains in neuroscience — and the interface you design is how millions of women could first experience neurotechnology. Few engineering roles let you draw a straight line from your commits to systemic change in mental health. This one does.
 



**The Team You’ll Join** 


 You’ll work alongside a world\-class mental health team — neuroscientists, clinicians, researchers, and engineers who have dedicated their careers to understanding the brain and closing the gender gap in brain health. This means your day\-to\-day includes conversations most developers never get to have: reviewing features with scientists who study the very signals your app displays, and building alongside people who deeply understand the problem you’re solving.
 





 We’re a small, mission\-driven team, which means your voice carries. You won’t be a ticket\-taker — you’ll help shape the product, the architecture, and the company itself.
 



**The Role** 


 We’re looking for a mid\-level Mobile Developer (2–4 years of experience) to build our iOS and Android app. Our primary stack is React Native, but we’re open to building in other native mobile languages (Swift, Kotlin, Java) where it makes sense — what matters is shipping a great mobile experience. You’ll own front\-end development end to end, connect the app to our backend services, and help integrate it with the neurotechnology hardware our team is building.
 



**What You’ll Do** 
* Build and maintain our mobile app for iOS and Android — primarily in React Native, with native code where it serves the product best
* Translate designs into polished, responsive, and accessible user interfaces
* Integrate the front end with our backend services and APIs, including authentication, data sync, and real\-time features
* Help integrate the app with our hardware systems — device pairing, data streaming, and communication over Bluetooth/BLE and native bridges if needed
* Write native modules or work with Java/Kotlin on the Android side when React Native alone isn’t enough
* Test, debug, and profile the app across devices, and support releases to the App Store and Google Play
* Collaborate with design, backend, and hardware teammates to shape the product as it grows


**What You Bring** 
* 2–4 years of professional software development experience, with solid production experience in React Native or comparable native mobile development
* Working knowledge of Java (Android native modules, debugging, or backend exposure)
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals and experience with state management, navigation, and API integration in mobile apps
* Experience shipping apps to the App Store and/or Google Play
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup environment — taking ownership, wearing multiple hats, and learning as you go
* Care for the mission: building technology that improves mental health, especially for women


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience integrating mobile apps with hardware or wearables (Bluetooth/BLE, sensors, streaming data)
* Deeper experience in Swift/Objective\-C or Kotlin for fully native development
* Exposure to health, wellness, or regulated\-data products (e.g., HIPAA/PHIPA awareness)
* Experience with CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, EAS, App Center, etc.)


**Details** 
* Employment type: Full\-time
* Location: Remote


**How to Apply** 


 Send us your resume along with links to apps you’ve built or shipped (App Store, Google Play, or GitHub). A short note on why this mission matters to you goes a long way. In this form:
 
 https://forms.gle/41j2jqC27RDRiP9c9

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Company Description
 
**Cligent Aerospace** 
 is developing hybrid\-electric short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft designed to move freight reliably across challenging routes. The company focuses on “Trucks in the Sky” that can operate from simple airstrips and calm waters, connecting coastlines, islands, river deltas, and remote locations over distances up to 800 kilometers. These aircraft are built as workhorses for cargo, not luxury travel, enabling access to places where traditional vehicles and aircraft struggle to operate. Cligent Aerospace is driven by a mission to transform regional logistics on land and sea, from arctic outposts to tropical archipelagos, wherever freight needs to move.
 



  




 Role Description
 
 This is a internship/ full\-time, on\-site
 **Embedded Engineer** 
 role based in Ahmedabad. The Embedded Engineer will be responsible for the design, development, integration, and validation of embedded systems for hybrid\-electric aircraft. The role involves developing embedded software and hardware interfaces for flight\-critical systems, powertrain controllers, sensors, and communication networks. The engineer will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to develop MATLAB/Simulink models, generate and validate control algorithms, create Python scripts for automation and data analysis, and support Embedded C implementation for electronic control units (ECUs).
 



  





 The position includes powertrain wiring integration, system bring\-up, hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing, debugging, and verification of embedded platforms. The Embedded Engineer will also prepare technical documentation, support research and development (R\&D) activities, and contribute to the continuous improvement of aircraft electrical and embedded systems while ensuring compliance with aerospace engineering standards.
 



  




 Qualifications
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Strong experience in
 **Embedded C/C\+\+** 
 programming for microcontrollers and real\-time embedded systems.
* Proficiency in
 **MATLAB/Simulink** 
 for modeling, simulation, and control algorithm development.
* Experience developing
 **Python scripts** 
 for automation, testing, data processing, and engineering analysis.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Embedded Coder** 
 , code generation, and integration of Simulink models into embedded platforms.
* Knowledge of
 **aircraft electrical systems** 
 ,
 **hybrid\-electric powertrain wiring** 
 , harness integration, and system\-level debugging.
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as
 **CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet** 
 , and related diagnostic tools.
* Experience with embedded debugging tools, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and version control systems (Git).
* Ability to develop and maintain
 **technical documentation** 
 , including design specifications, interface documents, test procedures, validation reports, and engineering change records.
* Understanding of control systems, sensors, actuators, and embedded hardware\-software integration.
* Experience in
 **R\&D** 
 , rapid prototyping, system integration, and validation testing in aerospace, automotive, robotics, or other safety\-critical industries is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.

 职位介绍 岗位职责： 1\. 北美区公司级HR统筹管理：全面负责分公司HR体系搭建与运营管理，推动海外HR团队与国内总部管理闭环。 2\. 薪酬福利与成本管控：统筹海外及国内薪酬体系、奖金激励、社保福利、工会相关工作及人力成本预算分析。 3\. 劳动关系与合规管理：负责国内外用工合规、劳动合同与制度体系维护，处理劳动争议风险及员工关系管理。 4\. 组织发展与整合支持：支持海外公司组织整合、干部管理、绩效体系落地及关键人才引进与保留。 任职要求： 1\. 本科及以上学历，5年以上HR经验，2年以上人力资源管理岗位经验。 2\. 北美连续工作经验2年以上，熟悉北美用工合规逻辑与管理方式。 3\. 英语可作为工作语言，可独立对接海外研发中心与生产基地管理层。 4\. 精通薪酬福利、社保税务、人力成本管理，有海外薪资/福利/工会相关经验优先。 4\. 具备跨文化沟通能力，有制造业/航空/高端装备背景优先。 其他信息 语言要求：英语、普通话 行业要求：全部行业
   

  

 公司简介
   

  

 万丰奥特控股集团（以下简称“万丰集团”）创立于1994年，是一家“大交通”领域以先进制造业为核心的国际化企业。一直以来，万丰集团秉持“实业报国、产业强国”的责任使命，遵循“永恒提升价值、不断奉献社会”的理想信念，产业涉足汽车部件、航空工业、智能装备、金融投资等领域，致力于“营造国际品牌、构筑百年企业”。 历经20多年的发展，万丰集团资产超300亿元、员工1\.5万人以上，位列中国民营企业500\*强、中国汽车工业30强、浙江省100强，已形成轻量化应用汽车部件和通用飞机制造“双引擎”驱动的发展格局，打造全球汽车金属部件轻量化推动者和领\*导者、通用飞机创新制造企业的全球领跑者。其中：轻量化铝轮、新材料镁合金产业实现细分市场全球；新工艺涂覆、智能装备工业机器人产业实现细分市场国内；战略性新兴产业通航产业成为全国民企集飞机制造、机场建设、航校培训、通航运营、低空保障、航空俱乐部等于一体全产业链的样板，占地5\.5平方公里的万丰航空小镇已列入国家通用航空综合示范区、国家空中游览基地、国家飞行营地、浙江省特色小镇，所产拥有全部知识产权的钻石通航飞机进入世界品牌前三强。借助上市公司平台，万丰集团朝着行业领\*先、向千亿目标迈进，从经营国际化向资本、人才、科技、品牌国际化转型升级。 步入新发展阶段，贯彻新发展理念，融入新发展格局，万丰集团将牢牢抓住国家大力发展战略性新兴产业的历史机遇，践行《中国制造2025》战略和“国际国内双循环”新发展格局，专注实体经济，弘扬工匠精神，以数字经济为牵引，以实业经营为基础，不断扩大产业规模，带动周边群体共享发展，实现“百强百誉百年万丰”的战略目标，争当浙江省高质量发展共同富裕标杆企业，为振兴地方经济、推动行业进步、促进社会发展贡献万丰更多的智慧和力量。

title: Human Resources HR Manager
description:
**Job Application Form** 
 :
 



 https://forms.gle/z76sPvhFyi9pEfs47
 



 \*This form is mandatory.
 



  





**Work Location:** 
 Head Office, Whitefield, Bengaluru (Work from Office)
 



**Minimum Work Experience: 4 Years** 




**Contact Details:** 
 HR: hr@vaibhav\-vyapaar.com  \| hr@capfront.in
 



  





**Overview of the Role:** 




 We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior HR Professional to lead and strengthen our Human Resources function. The role will be responsible for developing HR strategies, driving talent acquisition, employee engagement, performance management, HR compliance, and organizational development. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership capabilities and experience in building high\-performing teams within a fast\-paced organization.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ·    MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
 



 ·    5–10 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in NBFC, FinTech, Banking, or technology\-driven organizations.
 



 ·    Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
 



 ·    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Google Workspace.
 



 ·    Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, employment regulations, and HR best practices.
 



 ·    Proven experience in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, employee engagement, and HR operations.
 



 ·    Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 ·    Experience with HRMS platforms and HR analytics.
 



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 ·    Experience working in high\-growth startups or rapidly scaling organizations.
 



 ·    Exposure to organizational restructuring, change management, and HR policy development.
 



 ·    Strong business partnering experience with senior leadership.
 



 ·    Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor HR teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ·    Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the organization's business objectives.
 



 ·    Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions.
 



 ·    Drive employee engagement, retention, and organizational culture initiatives.
 



 ·    Design and manage performance management frameworks and appraisal processes.
 



 ·    Develop succession planning and leadership development programs.
 



 ·    Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
 



 ·    Oversee compensation, benefits, and rewards programs.
 



 ·    Manage employee relations and resolve workplace conflicts effectively.
 



 ·    Develop and review HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbooks.
 



 ·    Monitor HR metrics and provide insights to leadership for strategic decision\-making.
 



 ·    Lead HR technology implementation and process automation initiatives.
 



 ·    Manage and mentor the HR team while fostering a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**Opportunity** 




 At LoanFront, we take pride in delivering innovative FinTech solutions that address our customers' evolving needs. We are seeking ambitious and analytical professionals who can contribute to our growth and expansion. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment and possess strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to strategic business initiatives across the organization. At LoanFront, we provide a dynamic learning environment that fosters professional growth, skill development, and domain expertise, enabling you to build a rewarding career in the FinTech industry.
 



  





**About the Company** 




 CapFront Technologies is a privately held FinTech company based in Bengaluru, India. The company develops technology products and provides IT services to financial institutions, banks, and NBFCs. CapFront leverages modern technology and advanced analytics to help clients improve portfolio performance and operational efficiency. The company supports its partners across the lending lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, collections, and risk management, through its proprietary digital infrastructure.
 



 CapFront's flagship product, LoanFront, is a digital lending platform trusted by over 5 million customers and rated 4\.5 stars on app stores. Since its launch in 2019, LoanFront has facilitated loan disbursements exceeding ₹1,600 crore.
 



 We are looking for inquisitive and driven individuals to join us on our growth journey. 🚀

title: People Services Manager-India
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 The People Services Manager role will be the key lead in developing efficient people services to support our People Function for the country that enhances the overall employee experience.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
 People Services Delivery and Transformation
   

  

* Establish a high\-performing People Services team with a healthy balance between globalized and localized activities
* Implement the globally defined processes and procedures for people service delivery, and ensure they are compliant with local labor law

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Job Description For Scrum Master**
 We are seeking a high\-caliber
 **Scrum Master** 
 who transcends the role of a traditional "process facilitator." You aren't just here to run ceremonies; you are a strategic leader tasked with fostering a high\-performance culture, driving radical transparency, and ensuring our Agile maturity translates directly into business value.
   

  

 As a
 **Strategic Scrum Master** 
 , you will serve as the bridge between corporate strategy and team execution, acting as a trusted advisor to stakeholders and a catalyst for relentless improvement within your squads.
   

  

**Core Leadership Competencies**
* Customer\-Centric Mindset (Outcome Focused): Shift the team’s focus from "completing tickets" to "delivering value." Partner with Product Owners to ensure every sprint goal is tied to a measurable business outcome.
* Enterprise Mindset: Navigate the complexities of a global organization, ensuring local initiatives align with broad corporate strategy and do not negatively impact other business units.
* Strategic Partnership Enabler (Build Trust): Cultivate high\-integrity relationships with stakeholders through radical transparency, moving the role from a "service provider" to a "trusted advisor."
* Consultative Approach: Act as an internal expert who diagnoses business needs and offers data\-driven recommendations rather than simply executing requested tasks.
* Conflict Resolution: Facilitate the healthy exchange of opposing views to reach "win\-win" compromises that keep momentum high without damaging cross\-functional relationships.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Instill a culture of "relentless improvement" by systematically analyzing failures and successes to refine workflows and reduce waste.


**Technical \& Practitioner Skills**
 Beyond leadership, the successful candidate must possess a deep "Agile Toolbox" to guide the team through technical and procedural hurdles:
   

  

* Agile Framework Expertise: Advanced mastery of Scrum, Kanban, and Lean principles. Ability to blend methodologies (e.g., Scrumban) to fit the specific needs of the team’s workflow.
* Facilitation Mastery: Expert at leading high\-engagement Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives that result in actionable improvements.
* Backlog Refinement \& Management: Skilled in helping Product Owners manage a healthy, prioritized backlog and assisting the team in decomposing complex epics into clear, testable user stories.
* Metrics \& Data Literacy: Proficiency in tracking and interpreting Agile metrics such as Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, and Burndown charts to predict delivery and identify bottlenecks.
* Impediment Removal: Proactive identification and neutralization of technical and organizational blockers, often before they impact the team’s velocity.
* Scaling Knowledge: Understanding of scaling frameworks (such as SAFe, LeSS, or Spotify Model) to coordinate dependencies across multiple teams.
* SDLC Fluency: A solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle, including CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automated testing, to better support the team's technical excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach in a complex, enterprise\-level environment.
* Certifications: PSM II/III, CSM, or SAFe Agilist preferred.
* Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical blockers into business\-impact language for non\-technical leaders.
* Tooling: Expert\-level proficiency in Jira/Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar enterprise ALM tools.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

description:
**Overview**
 Location: Chennai
   

  

 The Data Governance Business Analyst plays a pivotal role in standardizing data entry processes, improving data quality, and strengthening the organization's data governance framework. This position acts as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business needs are clearly translated into actionable data governance requirements. The analyst partners with data owners, stewards, and IT to define data standards, guide policy implementation, and align data solutions with business objectives. This role helps deliver scalable solutions that enhance data quality, integrity, and usability across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to gather business requirements related to data governance, process improvements, and system changes.

* Lead process mapping to document and standardize data entry and management processes, identifying gaps and partnering with stakeholders to design improved future\-state processes.
* Lead triage efforts for data issues, coordinating with stakeholders to prioritize resolution.
* Establish and manage a standardized process for escalating and resolving data issues, ensuring proper documentation and stakeholder involvement.
* Coordinate root cause analysis and impact assessment for data issues, and prioritize remediation efforts based on business value and risk.
* Work with data owners, stewards, and custodians to ensure effective data management practices.
* Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to stakeholders at multiple levels of the organization.
* Develop training materials and deliver user training related to new processes, standards, or data governance tools.

* Lead change impact assessments using quantitative evidence.

 B.E/B.Tech IT/ CS with 5\+ plus years of experience in business analytics.

title: Senior Associate - Human Resources
description:
**Department:** Human Resources

**Reporting To:** Head HR

**About the Role**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, proactive, and employee\-centric **Senior Associate / Assistant Manager \- Human Resources** to manage end\-to\-end HR Operations and Generalist activities. The ideal candidate will possess 6\-7 years of hands\-on experience across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, induction, HR administration, payroll coordination, benefits administration, statutory compliance, employee relations, grievance handling, training coordination, and exit management.

The role requires strong process orientation, stakeholder management skills, and thorough knowledge of HR policies, labor laws, and compliance requirements to ensure seamless HR operations and a positive employee experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Employee Onboarding \& Joining Formalities

* Manage and coordinate end\-to\-end onboarding processes for new hires.
* Ensure collection and verification of all joining documents.
* Prepare employment letters, contracts, and onboarding documentation.
* Coordinate induction programs and facilitate smooth employee integration.
* Maintain employee records and HRIS updates accurately.

2\. HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management

* Manage employee data and records throughout the employment lifecycle.
* Administer employee confirmations, transfers, promotions, and internal movements.
* Maintain HR databases, personnel files, and organizational records.
* Ensure timely issuance of HR letters including:
* Appointment Letters
* Confirmation Letters
* Promotion Letters
* Transfer Letters
* Experience Letters
* Relieving Letters

3\. Payroll Administration

* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with accounting / finance teams.
* Validate attendance, leave records, incentives, reimbursements, and deductions.
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Reconcile payroll reports and resolve employee payroll queries.
* Support annual tax declarations, proofs collection, and payroll audits.

4\. Statutory Compliance \& Labour Law Administration

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory regulations.
* Manage compliance related to:
* PF
* ESIC
* Professional Tax
* Gratuity
* Shops \& Establishment Act
* Labour Welfare Fund
* Maternity Benefits
* POSH Compliance
* Coordinate internal and external compliance audits.
* Maintain relevant statutory records and registers.

5\. Employee Benefits \& Insurance Management

* Administer employee health insurance, group medical policies, and other employee benefits programs.
* Coordinate policy enrolments, additions, deletions, and claims support.
* Act as a liaison between employees and insurance providers.
* Ensure effective communication of benefit programs to employees.

6\. Learning \& Development Coordination

* Coordinate employee induction and training programs.
* Manage training nomination processes and attendance tracking.
* Maintain training records and learning databases.
* Support HR in competency development initiatives and employee engagement programs.
* Assist in evaluating training effectiveness and feedback collection.

7\. Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries and concerns.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Support implementation of employee engagement initiatives.
* Foster a positive workplace culture and employee experience.
* Assist in conflict resolution and disciplinary processes.

8\. Performance Management Support

* Support execution of performance appraisal cycles.
* Coordinate goal\-setting, review discussions, and performance documentation.
* Generate performance\-related reports and analytics.
* Ensure timely completion of performance management activities.

9\. Exit Management \& Full and Final Settlement

* Manage resignation and separation processes.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyze feedback trends.
* Coordinate asset recovery and clearance procedures.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters.
* Facilitate Full \& Final (F\&F) settlement processes.

10\. HR Policies, MIS \& Reporting

* Support development and implementation of HR policies and SOPs.
* Generate and maintain HR dashboards and MIS reports.
* Track key HR metrics such as:
* Headcount
* Attrition
* Joining vs. Exit Trends
* Training Coverage
* Employee Turnover
* Compliance Status
* Analyze HR data and provide actionable insights to management.

11\. HR Audits \& Process Improvement

* Participate in internal and external HR audits.
* Ensure proper documentation and process adherence.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency.
* Support HR transformation and digitization initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or other graduate degree with HR Specialization
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification preferred.
* 6\-7 years of experience in HR Operations and Generalist functions.
* Experience handling employee lifecycle management in medium to large organizations.

**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

Functional Skills

* HR Operations
* Payroll Administration
* Statutory Compliance
* Employee Onboarding \& Offboarding
* Benefits \& Insurance Management

Technical Skills

Behavioral Competencies

 **Organization Context**


Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.

  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

 **Business Context**


Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management.

 **Job Context:**

  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls

* Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).

 **Yield \& Profitability Management**

* Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management**
